title: Stateful Guardrails for Multi-Turn LLM Systems: A Conversational Risk Accumulation Framework
summary: Most safety guardrails for large language models (LLMs) evaluate each prompt-response pair in isolation, which misses failures that arise only over a dialogue as benign turns compose into harm. We term this Conversational Risk Accumulation (CRA): gradual intent drift, fragmented assembly of prohibited instructions, and sensitivity build-up from repeated disclosures. We propose a session-layer CRA Framework that tracks three trajectory signals: semantic drift from a session anchor, a sensitivity-weighted information accumulation graph over extracted entities, and a compliance-gradient signal capturing increasing willingness to comply. For scoring, we provide (i) an unsupervised convex fusion for attribution and ablations, and (ii) CRA-Net DA, a compact learned trajectory model trained with family-adversarial objectives to reduce length and topic-coverage confounds. To benchmark CRA, we release CRA-Bench v0.1 (1,200 eight-turn sessions across three threat families with topic-matched benign twins), CRA-Bench v0.2 (LLM-paraphrased variants to reduce template artifacts), and an extended 5-family set (2,000 sessions adding persona priming and context stuffing). We introduce a trajectory-native evaluation protocol with session-level splits, mixed-set threshold calibration, Trajectory AUROC, turns-to-detection, calibrated false-positive metrics, bootstrap confidence intervals, leave-one-family-out diagnostic stress tests, and synthetic-to-human transfer checks. Claims focus on within-distribution session scoring on CRA-Bench and human-transfer subsets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出会话风险累积（CRA）概念，指LLM在多轮对话中逐步产生危害。构建了CRA框架，通过三个轨迹信号（语义漂移、信息累积图、遵从梯度）检测风险，并发布CRA-Bench基准数据集和评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全护栏仅评估单轮对话，忽略了多轮交互中良性轮次组合成危害的风险（如意图漂移、指令碎片化、敏感信息累积）。
AI.method: 提出会话层CRA框架，追踪三个轨迹信号：语义漂移、敏感加权信息累积图、遵从梯度。提供无监督凸融合打分和CRA-Net DA轨迹模型，采用家族对抗训练减少长度和主题覆盖混淆。发布CRA-Bench数据集（含多个版本），设计轨迹原生评估协议。
AI.result: 在CRA-Bench v0.1（1200个8轮会话，3类威胁）和v0.2（LLM改写变体）及5类扩展集（2000会话）上评估，采用Trajectory AUROC、检出轮次、校准假阳性等指标，并进行留一法压力测试和合成到人工迁移检查。
AI.conclusion: CRA框架能有效检测多轮对话中的累积风险，轨迹级评估优于单轮方法，数据集和协议为后续研究提供基准。

title: When Reasoning Narrows the Move: Diversity Collapse in LLM Game Play
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used to adapt large language models to downstream tasks, but its effect on behavioral diversity in sequential decision-making remains under-explored. We study this question in a controlled suite of deterministic board games based on tic-tac-toe variants, where optimal actions are exactly computable and diversity can be measured directly. Across state-level evaluation, arena gameplay, and training trajectories, we find that reasoning-mode generation frequently suppresses action diversity without uniformly improving action accuracy. Furthermore, standard SFT improves accuracy but often induces premature diversity collapse, which exceeds what is minimally required by the accuracy-diversity tradeoff. We then show that action augmentation, which trains on all optimal actions per state rather than a single demonstrated action, would partially mitigates this effect. Our results identify narrow-support imitation as a source of policy collapse in LLM decision-making and suggest that preserving action support during SFT is important for maintaining exploratory behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在监督微调(SFT)大语言模型进行序列决策时，虽然能提升准确性，但会导致行为多样性过度降低，而动作增强（训练所有最优动作而非单个）可部分缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 监督微调(SFT)广泛应用但对其如何影响序列决策中的行为多样性尚不明确，需要在可控环境下系统研究准确性与多样性的权衡关系。
AI.method: 在井字棋变体等确定性棋盘游戏套件中进行控制实验，通过状态级评估、竞技场对弈和训练轨迹分析，对比推理模式生成与标准SFT对动作多样性的影响，并测试动作增强方法。
AI.result: 推理模式生成常抑制动作多样性但未一致提升准确性；标准SFT提升准确性但导致早期多样性崩溃，超过准确率-多样性权衡所需的最小值；动作增强可部分缓解多样性过度降低问题。
AI.conclusion: 窄支持模仿是LLM决策中策略崩溃的根源，在SFT过程中保持动作支持（即保留多种最优动作选项）对维持探索性行为至关重要。

title: On the Computational Complexity of Structural Generalization
summary: Structural generalization has been measured repeatedly by several benchmarks, yet it has never been formally defined. We give a definition that translates the two premises (compositional structure and unbounded generalization) into mathematical language. The definition itself is neutral: a compiler that hard-codes the rules satisfies it just as well. But structural generalization becomes a scientific question only insofar as the capacity can autonomously emerge from finite data. This question pits the computational lower bound $\mathrm{NC}^1$ against the learnable ceiling $\mathrm{TC}^0$ of pure Transformers. Under a Montagovian instantiation, each compositional rule splits into two projections: a syntactic face ($F_γ$) and a semantic face ($G_γ$). Tree evaluation on the $G_γ$ side is an instantiation of BFVP, which is $\mathrm{NC}^1$-complete (Buss, 1987). A pure Transformer must learn both faces at once, but Kraus et al. (2026) prove that its learnable class $\subseteq \mathrm{TC}^0$. Under the standard assumption $\mathrm{TC}^0 \neq \mathrm{NC}^1$, a pure Transformer cannot learn structural generalization. Neuro-symbolic systems achieve the best benchmark scores precisely because they inject $G_γ$, sidestepping the genuinely hard half. Benchmark scores cannot distinguish "learned" from "given." This is what this paper sets out to make clear.

AI.tldr: 本文首次形式化定义了结构泛化，并证明在标准计算复杂度假设下，纯Transformer无法学习结构泛化，而神经符号系统之所以得分高是因为注入了语义面，绕过了真正困难的部分。
AI.motivation: 结构泛化虽被多个基准测试反复衡量，却从未被正式定义。本文旨在用数学语言给出定义，并澄清基准测试分数无法区分"学习"与"给定"的问题。
AI.method: 将结构泛化的两个前提（组合结构与无界泛化）翻译成数学语言；在蒙塔古框架下将每个组合规则拆分为句法面F_γ和语义面G_γ；利用树评估（BFVP，NC^1-完全问题）和Transformer可学习类⊆TC^0的结论，在TC^0≠NC^1假设下进行理论分析。
AI.result: 在TC^0≠NC^1的标准假设下，纯Transformer无法学习结构泛化。神经符号系统通过注入G_γ（语义面）来获得高分，但这绕过了真正困难的部分。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试分数无法区分模型是"学到"了结构泛化还是被"给定"了关键信息；纯Transformer存在理论上的学习上限，而神经符号系统的高分是靠注入而非学习获得的。

title: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
comment: Preprint, 22 pages, 14 figures. Dataset collection available at https://huggingface.co/collections/nace-ai/hypernetwork-datasets
summary: Injecting factual knowledge into large language models (LLMs) reliably and at scale remains an open challenge. Hypernetworks provide a promising solution to large-scale knowledge injection. Although hypernetworks are typically applied for test-time adaptation, we explore their use in train-time knowledge injection, where, given a large corpus of facts, we train a hypernetwork to generate a fixed LoRA adapter that, when inserted into the target model, enable the model to answer questions about those facts. In this work, we investigate whether hypernetworks can be used to perform train-time knowledge injection and how this ability varies with scale. The scaling behavior of hypernetworks remains largely unstudied. Our design decouples the hypernetwork's injection capacity from the target model's general capability, enabling, for the first time, a rigorous study of scaling laws for hypernetwork architectures. We characterize how loss, reasoning accuracy, and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization vary with hypernetwork depth, width, and target network size. We construct a large-scale dataset, called MegaWikiQA, containing tens of millions of multi-hop question-answer examples across 39 domains constructed from examples in Wikidata5M. Our results reveal: (i) hypernetwork-based injection exhibits broadly predictive power law scaling along all architecture axes; and (ii) hypernetworks are capable of reliable OOD generalization at increasing scales, suggesting that hypernetwork provides a promising alternative to other train-time adaptation methods such as LoRA finetuning and full fine-tuning, exhibiting steeper scaling exponents in all OOD evaluations. Together, these results establish hypernetworks as a principled and scalable substrate for train-time adaptation, and provide the first empirically grounded scaling laws to guide hypernetworks for factual reasoning in large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超网络（Hypernetwork）在大规模语言模型中用于训练时知识注入（train-time knowledge injection）的能力，构建了MegaWikiQA数据集，揭示了超网络在损失、推理准确率和OOD泛化方面遵循幂律缩放规律，且相比LoRA微调和全微调展现出更优的缩放性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型可靠且可扩展的事实知识注入仍是一个开放挑战。虽然超网络通常用于测试时自适应，但作者探索其在训练时知识注入中的应用，并研究其缩放行为（此前未被系统研究）。
AI.method: 设计了一种解耦超网络注入能力与目标模型通用能力的架构，训练超网络生成固定的LoRA适配器插入目标模型；构建了包含数千万多跳问答样本的大型数据集MegaWikiQA（覆盖39个领域），系统分析超网络的深度、宽度及目标网络大小对损失、推理准确率和OOD泛化的影响。
AI.result: (i) 超网络知识注入在所有架构维度上遵循可预测的幂律缩放规律；(ii) 超网络在更大规模下展现出可靠的OOD泛化能力，在所有OOD评估中比LoRA微调和全微调具有更陡峭的缩放指数。
AI.conclusion: 超网络为训练时自适应提供了一种有原则且可扩展的方案，并首次提供了经验支撑的缩放定律来指导超网络在大语言模型事实推理中的应用。

title: Detect Early, Escalate Rarely: Anytime Detection of AI-Generated Video from the Compressed Bitstream
summary: Detectors for AI-generated video are evaluated offline. A clip is decoded to pixels and scored once, increasingly by a large vision-language model. Detection, however, is deployed online. We recast the task as streaming perception and score the motion field the codec already wrote into the bitstream. Reading that field is a parse, not a pixel-domain forward pass. Because the running aggregate is monotone, one end-calibrated threshold is anytime-valid at the data-dependent decision time. Recalibrating at each prefix is not. Escalation is priced in closed form. A compute budget maps to a deferral window, on a frontier monotone exactly where the deferral condition holds. On matched GenVidBench the codec stage reaches full-length AUC 0.64 at five orders of magnitude less compute than a pixel CNN, on CPU. Its gate holds the stopping-time false-positive rate at target while the real data match its calibration, and drifts above it under distribution shift. Deferring 15% of clips lifts accuracy from 0.75 to 0.78 at $7\times$ less compute (paired: McNemar $p<10^{-6}$). The stage-1 ordering replicates on AIGVDBench. We introduce no new detector. The contribution is the reframing, two guarantees, and the measured frontiers. Code, configurations, and evaluation splits: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/streamdet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将AI生成视频检测从离线像素评分重构为在线流式感知任务，直接解析码流中的运动场信息，并提供了任意时间有效的阈值保证和计算预算映射的延迟窗口，在GenVidBench上以五个数量级更少的计算量达到AUC 0.64，门控机制可控制停止时间假阳性率。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成视频检测器在离线环境下评估，将视频解码为像素后评分，但实际部署是在线流式环境。这种离线评估与在线部署之间的不匹配导致检测效率低下、计算开销大。
AI.method: 将检测重新定义为流式感知任务，直接解析编解码器已写入码流的运动场（而非像素域前向传播）；利用单调累积量实现单阈值任意时间有效；以闭式定价计算升级成本；将计算预算映射为延迟窗口。
AI.result: 在GenVidBench上，编解码器阶段以比像素CNN少五个数量级的计算量（在CPU上）达到全长AUC 0.64；门控机制在数据匹配校准时保持停止时间假阳性率在目标水平，分布偏移时漂移上升；延迟15%视频片段可将准确率从0.75提升至0.78，减少7倍计算量（McNemar p<10^{-6}）。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献在于任务重构、两种理论保证以及实测的前沿性能，并未引入新的检测器。代码和配置已开源。

title: FineServe: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Characterization of Global LLM Serving Workloads
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as always-on online services, making efficient LLM serving a critical systems challenge. Achieving low latency and high throughput under volatile demand requires deep understanding of real-world serving workloads, yet existing studies often rely on proxy traces or coarse-grained characterizations that fail to capture the heterogeneity of modern multi-model LLM platforms. We present FineServe, an in-the-wild, multi-model LLM serving workload dataset collected from a global commercial marketplace, enabling fine-grained characterization of real-world serving dynamics across heterogeneous models and tasks. Leveraging FineServe, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of arrival dynamics and token behavior, revealing fundamentally different fluctuation regimes across model architectures, scales and task intents. Building on these insights, we develop the FineServe workload generator, which composes fine-grained model-aware workloads into configurable mixtures tailored for benchmarking multi-model serving platforms. By exposing these fine-grained workload dynamics, FineServe provides a realistic foundation for evaluating routing, scheduling, and capacity-planning strategies in LLM serving systems. FineServe is available at https://github.com/hihiztc1/FineServe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FineServe，一个来自全球商业市场的多模型LLM服务真实工作负载数据集，揭示了不同模型架构和任务意图下的请求到达动态和令牌行为差异，并开发了细粒度的工作负载生成器，用于评估多模型服务平台的调度和容量规划策略。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务负载研究多依赖代理轨迹或粗粒度特征描述，无法捕捉现代多模型LLM平台中负载的异构性和真实动态特性，亟需一个细粒度、真实场景下的多模型服务负载数据集。
AI.method: 从全球商业市场收集真实多模型LLM服务负载数据，构建FineServe数据集；通过细粒度分析请求到达动态和令牌行为，识别不同模型架构、规模和任务意图下的波动模式；并开发可配置的细粒度工作负载生成器。
AI.result: 发现不同模型架构、规模和任务意图下存在根本不同的负载波动模式；FineServe能够为多模型服务平台的基准测试提供真实、细粒度的负载基础。
AI.conclusion: FineServe为评估LLM服务系统中的路由、调度和容量规划策略提供了现实的基准，有助于优化低延迟和高吞吐的在线服务性能。

title: Task Competence Is Not Instruction Following: Evaluating Instruction-Conflicting Behavior in Small Language Models
summary: Instruction tuning is meant to make language models follow user requests, yet it is unclear whether small models comply when an instruction conflicts with their usual task behavior. We study this across three tasks - multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), sentiment classification, and mathematical question answering - by pairing a standard instruction with a conflicting non-standard one (select an incorrect option, output the opposite sentiment, or return twice the answer). This cross-task design allows us to test whether resistance to conflicting instructions is tied to specific task characteristics or reflects a broader behavioral tendency. As all predictions are scored against the original ground truth, a model that ignores the non-standard instruction still appears accurate. Using standard accuracy, non-standard accuracy, and an Instruction-Following Failure Rate (IFFR), we evaluate instruction-tuned Qwen models across sizes. Both standard accuracy and instruction following generally improve with scale, although the pattern is not consistent across all tasks and datasets. Small models stay competent yet routinely ignore the non-standard instruction, while larger models show a clear gap between the two settings. These findings suggest that gains in task capability do not automatically provide reliable control over model behavior. Task competence and instruction following are therefore distinct abilities, and reporting only standard accuracy hides instruction-following failures.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比标准指令与冲突指令（如选择错误选项、输出相反情感等），发现大语言模型在指令遵循与任务能力之间存在显著差距，且仅在标准准确率上评估会掩盖指令遵循失败的问题。
AI.motivation: 探究小模型在指令与常规任务行为冲突时是否仍能遵循用户指令，以及这种抵抗是否与具体任务特征相关。
AI.method: 设计三类任务（MCQA、情感分类、数学问答），每类任务配对一个标准指令与一个冲突指令（选错误项、输出相反情感、返回两倍答案），使用标准准确率、非标准准确率和指令遵循失败率（IFFR）评估不同规模的Qwen模型。
AI.result: 标准准确率和指令遵循能力总体随模型规模提升，但模式在各任务和数据集上不一致。小模型保持任务能力但常忽略冲突指令，大模型则在两个设置间表现出明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 任务能力与指令遵循是两种独立的能力，仅报告标准准确率会掩盖指令遵循失败，模型规模增长并不会自动带来对模型行为的可靠控制。

title: Hybrid LSTM-Graph Neural Framework for Robust Financial Fraud Detection and Adversarial Resilience
summary: Financial institutions face significant challenges in detecting sophisticated money laundering patterns, such as smurfing and layering, due to extreme data imbalance (0.13% fraud rate) and evolving adversarial evasion tactics. This paper proposes FraudShield AI, a hybrid framework that integrates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks with hand-crafted Graph Topological Features to capture both temporal sequences and structural relational context. By engineering network-centric features including PageRank Centrality, In-Degree dynamics, and a custom Flow Ratio, the system shifts the detection paradigm from isolated transaction analysis to network-level forensics. A Focal Loss objective is used to address class imbalance, and a dynamic thresholding mechanism is introduced to improve resilience against low-value smurfing attacks. Experimental evaluation on the PaySim dataset shows that the proposed hybrid model substantially outperforms Logistic Regression and XGBoost baselines in Precision, Recall, and F1-Score, particularly on hard-to-detect micro-transaction fraud patterns. An ablation study confirms the complementary contribution of both the temporal and topological components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FraudShield AI，一种融合LSTM网络与图拓扑特征的混合框架，用于检测洗钱模式。在PaySim数据集上，该模型在精确率、召回率和F1分数上显著优于逻辑回归和XGBoost基线，尤其擅长检测微交易欺诈模式。
AI.motivation: 金融机构在检测复杂洗钱模式（如smurfing和layering）时面临数据极度不平衡（欺诈率仅0.13%）和对抗性规避策略的挑战，现有方法难以有效应对。
AI.method: 提出FraudShield AI混合框架，融合LSTM网络（捕获时间序列）与手工设计的图拓扑特征（包括PageRank中心性、入度动态和自定义Flow Ratio），使用Focal Loss处理类别不平衡，并引入动态阈值机制增强对低价值smurfing攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在PaySim数据集上，混合模型在精确率、召回率和F1分数上显著优于逻辑回归和XGBoost基线，尤其对难以检测的微交易欺诈模式表现优异。消融实验证实了时间组件和图拓扑组件的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: FraudShield AI通过将检测范式从孤立交易分析转向网络级取证，有效提升了洗钱检测性能，为应对复杂金融欺诈提供了新思路。

title: Adaptive Capitulation: A Structural Failure Mode of LLM Responses in Vulnerability Contexts
summary: Large language models operating in emotionally sensitive contexts face a structural trilemma: when users in vulnerable states request information that may reinforce maladaptive attribution, current response architectures resolve the tension through protective restriction, uninflected facilitation, or unintegrated co-presence of both imperatives -- each preserving one objective at the cost of the other. Administering a three-turn escalating vulnerability vignette to three commercial LLMs (900 sessions across material, relational, and somatic status-proxy variants) and coding responses with two binary indices (VCC/VCI), we characterize a previously undocumented failure mode we term adaptive capitulation: the model validates the social injustice underlying the user's distress before pivoting to detailed facilitation of the very acquisition it nominally discouraged. We show that the trilemma is structural rather than incidental, and propose Minimal Reattributive Sufficiency (MRS), an architecture-neutral design principle that embeds a single reattributive cue within an otherwise validating response, preserving a pathway toward autonomous reattribution without contesting the user's stated goal.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了大语言模型在情感敏感场景中面临的结构性三难困境，发现了一种名为"适应性投降"(adaptive capitulation)的新型失败模式，并提出"最小归因充分性"(MRS)设计原则作为解决方案。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在处理处于脆弱状态用户的情感敏感请求时，现有响应架构（保护性限制、无差别促进、未整合共存）均牺牲了部分目标，缺乏既能维护用户福祉又不完全否定用户目标的平衡方案。
AI.method: 通过三轮递进式脆弱性小场景（涵盖物质、关系、躯体三种状态代理变体），对三个商业LLM进行900次会话测试，并用两个二元指标（VCC/VCI）对响应进行编码，识别出"适应性投降"这一未记录过的失败模式。
AI.result: 模型先验证用户痛苦背后的社会不公，然后转向详细促进其本应劝阻的行为，形成一种矛盾响应模式。验证了三难困境是结构性的而非偶然的。
AI.conclusion: 提出最小归因充分性（MRS）——一种架构无关的设计原则，在验证性响应中嵌入单一归因线索，在不质疑用户目标的前提下保留通向自主再归因的路径。

title: OpenEvoShield: Dual Non-Stationary Continual Defense for Open-World Multi-Agent System Attacks
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, where adversaries inject malicious instructions through inter-agent communication to propagate harmful behaviors. Unlike static threats, these attacks are doubly dynamic: adversaries refine injection strategies against deployed defenses while normal-agent behavior drifts with system expansion. Existing defenses treat deployment as a closed-world problem and degrade rapidly once either distribution shifts beyond training coverage. We propose OpenEvoShield, a co-evolutionary continual defense framework for LLM-MAS. An asymmetric rate controller (M1) decouples fast attack-side and slow normal-side learning rates from dual drift signals. A normal-boundary updater (M2) maintains a dynamic behavioral boundary at the slow rate, while an EWC-regularized policy ensemble (M3) fast-adapts without catastrophic forgetting. An energy-based multi-granularity detector (M4) fuses node-, subgraph-, and graph-level evidence to classify novel attacks as out-of-distribution. Experiments over 100 deployment rounds across five benchmarks and four MAS topologies show that OpenEvoShield outperforms static and continual baselines, detecting most previously unseen attacks while keeping false positive rates low.

AI.tldr: 提出了OpenEvoShield，一种针对LLM多智能体系统的共演化持续防御框架，通过解耦攻击侧和正常侧的学习速率、动态行为边界、EWC正则化策略集成以及能量多粒度检测器，有效应对部署环境中的双重动态分布偏移，在100轮实验中将未知攻击检测率提升至最优水平。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统在安全关键场景中面临对手通过智能体间通信注入恶意指令的威胁，且这种攻击具有双重动态性：对手会针对部署的防御策略调整注入策略，同时正常智能体的行为会随系统扩展发生漂移。现有防御将部署视为封闭世界问题，一旦分布偏移超出训练覆盖范围，防御性能急剧下降。
AI.method: 提出OpenEvoShield框架，包含四个模块：M1（非对称速率控制器）通过双漂移信号解耦快速攻击侧和慢速正常侧的学习速率；M2（正常边界更新器）以慢速维持动态行为边界；M3（EWC正则化策略集成）快速适应而不发生灾难性遗忘；M4（能量多粒度检测器）融合节点、子图和图级证据，将新型攻击分类为分布外样本。
AI.result: 在5个基准测试和4种MAS拓扑结构上进行了100轮部署实验，OpenEvoShield优于静态和持续学习基线方法，能够检测大多数前所未有的攻击，同时保持较低的误报率。
AI.conclusion: OpenEvoShield通过共演化持续防御框架有效解决了LLM多智能体系统中攻击策略与正常行为双重动态漂移带来的防御挑战，为安全关键场景下的LLM-MAS部署提供了可行的防御方案。

title: Synthetic and Derived Training Images for Campus Waste Detection: A Multi-Seed Evaluation with YOLOv8n
summary: Incorrect disposal can contaminate campus recycling streams, and a bin-mounted camera could provide feedback as an item is discarded. We evaluated whether synthetic and derived images improve a YOLOv8n detector for this view. The real dataset contained 148 campus photographs: 86 for training, 31 for validation, and 31 for testing. Twelve joint-training configurations varied the amount and source of added images. We repeated seven principal settings with four matched seeds and computed bootstrap percentile intervals over those seeds. The real-only model reached a mean mAP@0.5 of 0.691 [0.665, 0.722]. Background replacement reduced the mean to 0.560 [0.499, 0.619], isolated-object images gave 0.680 [0.644, 0.724], and the full augmentation pool gave 0.487 [0.438, 0.537]. We also tested hand-and-forearm composites because every real photo showed a held object. Two cutouts in the initial composite set came from test photographs, so we discarded that experiment, rebuilt the set with training-split cutouts, and reran all four seeds. The corrected paired difference was +0.034 [-0.063, 0.199], which does not support a reliable hand-composite effect. Single-seed transfer experiments produced source-dependent rankings between joint mixing and sequential pretraining. None of the evaluated configurations exceeded the real-only baseline. The reported intervals quantify seed variation; the 31-photo test set remains too small for strong class-specific conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了在垃圾桶上方摄像头视角下，使用合成与衍生图像增强YOLOv8n检测器的效果。基于148张校园真实照片，12种联合训练配置均未超越仅使用真实图像的基线模型（mAP@0.5=0.691）。背景替换和全增强池反而降低了性能，手部复合图像的改进也不可靠。种子变异和测试集过小限制了结论的强度。
AI.motivation: 错误丢弃物品会污染校园回收流，安装在垃圾桶上的摄像头可在丢弃时提供即时反馈。本研究旨在探索合成与衍生图像能否提升垃圾桶视角下YOLOv8n目标检测器的性能，以弥补真实标注数据不足的问题。
AI.method: 使用YOLOv8n检测器，基于148张真实校园照片（86训练/31验证/31测试），设计12种联合训练配置，系统变化合成图像的来源和数量。通过4种匹配种子重复7个主要设置，计算自举百分位区间量化种子变异。额外测试了手部复合图像（因真实照片均为手持物品）和单种子迁移实验。
AI.conclusion: 当前实验条件下，合成与衍生图像未能提升垃圾桶视角下的检测性能。种子变异显著，31张测试集规模过小，无法得出强有力的类别特异性结论。未来需扩大真实数据集规模，并探索更有效的合成数据生成策略。

title: Benchmarking Confidential GPU Inference on NVIDIA H100 under Intel TDX
summary: Confidential computing is becoming a practical deployment requirement for AI inference workloads that process sensitive inputs or protect proprietary model assets. However, the performance cost of enabling confidential execution for GPU-accelerated large language model serving remains workload dependent and operationally important. This paper presents a benchmark study comparing standard non-confidential execution with confidential computing mode on a single NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU hosted in an Intel TDX confidential instance. The evaluation uses two representative language models, Mistral-7B v0.1 and Qwen3-30B-A3B, and measures time to first token, end-to-end request latency, per-request token generation throughput, global token throughput, and closed-loop request throughput under increasing concurrency. In fixed request-rate experiments, confidential mode increases average TTFT by 21.8% for Mistral-7B and 27.8% for Qwen3-30B-A3B, while global token throughput drops by 17.7% and 21.1%, respectively. In closed-loop concurrency experiments, throughput gaps remain in the 11.5-20.2% range, but the larger model reaches its saturation knee earlier under confidential mode. The results suggest that confidential GPU inference can retain usable throughput under load, but capacity planning must account for both the steady throughput penalty and the earlier saturation behavior observed for larger models.

AI.tldr: 本文在Intel TDX机密实例的单片NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU上，对Mistral-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B两种大语言模型进行了机密模式与非机密模式的性能基准对比研究。结果表明，机密模式导致首令牌延迟增加21.8%-27.8%，全局令牌吞吐量下降17.7%-21.1%，且大模型更早达到饱和点。
AI.motivation: 机密计算正成为处理敏感输入或保护专有模型资产的AI推理工作负载的实际部署需求，但启用机密执行对GPU加速的大语言模型服务的性能开销仍存在依赖工作负载的不确定性，因此需要进行系统的性能基准研究。
AI.method: 在Intel TDX机密实例的单片NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU上，对比标准非机密执行与机密计算模式。使用Mistral-7B v0.1和Qwen3-30B-A3B两个代表性模型，测量首令牌延迟、端到端请求延迟、每请求令牌生成吞吐量、全局令牌吞吐量和闭环请求吞吐量，并在递增并发下进行固定请求率实验和闭环并发实验。
AI.result: 固定请求率实验中，机密模式使平均首令牌延迟增加21.8%（Mistral-7B）和27.8%（Qwen3-30B-A3B），全局令牌吞吐量分别下降17.7%和21.1%。闭环并发实验中，吞吐量差距维持在11.5%-20.2%范围，但大模型在机密模式下更早达到饱和拐点。
AI.conclusion: 机密GPU推理在负载下仍可保持可用吞吐量，但容量规划必须同时考虑稳定的吞吐量惩罚以及大模型表现出的更早饱和行为。

title: Multi-Mask Diffusion Language Models for Few-Step Generation
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) are a promising family of language generators, but achieving high-quality few-step generation remains challenging. In MDMs, all forward trajectories collapse to a single fully masked state, leaving no terminal entropy for consistency-style few-step generation. While recent few-step alternatives based on uniform-state diffusion avoid this degeneracy, it becomes harder to distinguish clean tokens from noise than MDMs, which usually harms modeling quality and training efficiency. In this work, we propose a multi-mask diffusion model (MultiMDM) that preserves the masking structure towards few-step generation. In the forward process, each clean token is first pushed towards a designated mask and then gradually mixes over the mask set. As a result, the backward process has a drafting capability by predicting a designated mask before refining to a clean token. We derive a closed-form ELBO training objective for MultiMDM that supports continual training from pretrained MDMs. In addition, we formulate a purely discrete-state consistency distillation scheme, with a shared-Gumbel coupling to reduce pathwise entropy. Experiments on pretraining and distillation show that MultiMDM provides an effective foundation for principled few-step generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MultiMDM（多掩码扩散模型），通过在前向过程中先推送到指定掩码再混合到掩码集，保留掩码结构实现少步生成，并推导出闭式ELBO训练目标和离散状态一致性蒸馏方案，实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准MDM的前向轨迹坍缩到全掩码状态，缺乏终端熵，难以支持一致性风格的少步生成；而基于均匀态扩散的少步替代方法难以区分干净token和噪声，损害建模质量和训练效率。
AI.method: 1) 前向过程：每个干净token先推向指定掩码，再逐渐在掩码集上混合；2) 后向过程：通过预测指定掩码再精炼到干净token，具备草稿能力；3) 推导闭式ELBO训练目标，支持从预训练MDM持续训练；4) 提出纯离散状态一致性蒸馏方案，采用共享Gumbel耦合减少路径熵。
AI.result: 在预训练和蒸馏实验上，MultiMDM为原则性少步生成提供了有效基础。
AI.conclusion: MultiMDM通过多掩码设计同时保留了掩码结构优势，又实现了高效的少步生成，是MDM家族的有效扩展。

title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
summary: Long-video question answering requires a model to preserve visual evidence over time without repeatedly reprocessing the same video. A practical approach is to store the vision-language model's internal key-value (KV) cache for each video chunk and retrieve that state at query time. However, independently cached video chunks do not compose correctly: every chunk is prefilled from local rotary position zero, so naive concatenation collides temporal phases and removes the global order required for questions about what happened first, how often events occurred, or what changed across the video. This paper presents ChronoStitch, a training-free method for composing independently stored visual KV memories. The method first re-bases stored post-rotary keys onto a global three-axis multimodal RoPE coordinate system that preserves time, height, and width structure. We show why a one-dimensional scalar re-indexing is geometrically inconsistent for visual tokens because it turns spatial order within a frame into false temporal displacement. We then address the residual content gap left by positional repair: later chunks were originally encoded without attending to earlier chunks. ChronoStitch therefore selectively recomputes a small fraction of high-deviation later-chunk visual tokens while allowing them to attend over the composed cache. On Qwen2.5-VL-3B and the temporal split of TempCompass, ChronoStitch outperforms naive composition and position-only variants, improving event-ordering accuracy while running 3.3x faster than full joint re-prefilling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoStitch，一种无需训练的方法，通过重新对齐独立存储的视频块KV缓存中的旋转位置编码（RoPE），并选择性重计算少数高偏差视觉token，解决了长视频问答中因位置冲突和上下文缺失导致的时序推理错误，比完整重编码快3.3倍。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中，独立缓存每段视频的KV状态虽可避免重复处理，但各片段从局部旋转位置零开始填充，简单拼接会导致时间相位冲突，丢失全局时间顺序，无法正确回答关于事件先后顺序、频率或变化的问题。
AI.method: ChronoStitch包含两个关键步骤：(1) 将存储的旋转后键（post-rotary keys）重新映射到全局三维多模态RoPE坐标系（保留时间、高度、宽度结构），避免一维标量重索引导致的几何不一致；(2) 针对位置修复后仍存在的上下文缺失问题，选择性重计算后段视频中偏差较大的少量视觉token，使其能关注整个组合缓存。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B模型和TempCompass数据集的时间分割上，ChronoStitch在事件排序准确性上优于朴素拼接和仅位置修复的变体，同时运行速度比完整联合重新预填充快3.3倍。
AI.conclusion: ChronoStitch通过训练无关的位置重对齐与选择性重计算，有效解决了独立视频块KV缓存组合时的时序与上下文问题，为高效长视频问答提供了实用方案。

title: FormulaSPIN: Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Natural Language to Spreadsheet Formula Generation
comment: 15 pages,7 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference Oral
summary: Spreadsheet applications are used by hundreds of millions worldwide, yet writing formulas remains a significant barrier. Existing approaches rely on static supervised data, which quickly saturates on limited annotations. In this paper, we introduce FORMULASPIN, a self-play framework that breaks the ceiling of supervised fine-tuning by enabling iterative self-improvement without any additional data. Vanilla SPIN fails on this task: it uniformly penalizes every non-matching output, so execution-equivalent alternatives are punished as negatives in one example while serving as ground truth in another, producing contradictory gradients. Our framework resolves this by exploiting formula generation's unique advantage: binary executability provides implicit supervision that separates semantic errors from valid stylistic variants. We frame training as a two-player game in which the main player learns to prefer ground-truth formulas over those from its previous version, while execution feedback sorts outputs into distinct granularities-enabling an adaptive curriculum that shifts from semantic correctness to stylistic refinement. To further increase accuracy, we incorporate ExecVote, a semantic-level voting mechanism that naturally handles multiple valid formulations. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FORMULASPIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 74.9% exact match and 87.1% execution accuracy on NL2FORMULA, matching models trained with additional preference annotations while outperforming both traditional SFT and frontier proprietary models. These findings underscore self-play's potential to tackle scarce data tasks and open the door to extending it beyond executable domains.

AI.tldr: FORMULASPIN是一个自博弈框架，通过利用公式的可执行性作为隐式监督信号，突破了监督微调的性能天花板，在不增加额外数据的情况下实现迭代自我改进，在电子表格公式生成任务上达到SOTA性能（74.9%精确匹配，87.1%执行准确率）。
AI.motivation: 电子表格公式撰写对全球数亿用户仍构成重大障碍，现有方法依赖静态监督数据，在有限标注上迅速饱和，亟需一种无需额外数据即可持续自我改进的范式。
AI.method: 提出FORMULASPIN自博弈框架：(1) 利用公式的二进制可执行性作为隐式监督，区分语义错误和有效风格变体；(2) 设计双玩家博弈，主玩家学习偏好真实公式，执行反馈将输出按粒度排序，形成从语义正确性到风格优化的自适应课程；(3) 引入ExecVote语义级投票机制处理多种有效公式表述。
AI.result: 在NL2FORMULA基准上达到74.9%精确匹配和87.1%执行准确率，性能与使用额外偏好注释训练的模型相当，超越传统SFT和前沿商业模型。
AI.conclusion: 证明了自博弈在数据稀缺任务中的潜力，并为将其扩展到可执行领域之外开辟了道路。

title: SLPO: Scaling Latent Reasoning via a Surrogate Policy
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the predominant recipe for eliciting test-time scaling in explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoners. Yet this scaling path remains computationally costly, since every intermediate step must be decoded as a language token. Latent reasoning instead carries intermediate computation as continuous vectors and already matches or surpasses explicit CoT at far shorter horizons. Despite this promise, latent reasoners remain largely imitation-bound, while explicit CoT has already moved past imitation via outcome-reward RL. Latent trajectories lack a tractable per-step likelihood and an adaptive stopping interface under fixed thinking budgets, so outcome rewards cannot elicit latent test-time scaling. We introduce Surrogate Latent Policy Optimization (SLPO) to bring outcome-reward RL to autoregressive latent reasoners: an empirical surrogate policy density over latent transitions for trajectory-level credit assignment, and a correctness-supervised stopping head that outcome-reward optimization refines into a variable-horizon policy. Across continuous and soft thinking settings, SLPO improves Pass@$k$ under parallel sampling and allocates longer latent computation to harder instances with higher deterministic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLPO方法，将结果奖励强化学习引入自回归潜在推理器，通过代理策略密度和可停止机制实现潜在测试时扩展，在连续和软思考设置下提升Pass@k并将更长计算分配给更难实例。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链推理器的强化学习虽有效但计算成本高，而潜在推理器虽效率更优却仅限于模仿学习，无法像显式CoT那样通过结果奖励进行强化学习，因为潜在轨迹缺乏每步似然和自适应停止接口。
AI.method: 提出SLPO方法：1) 构建潜在过渡上的经验代理策略密度，实现轨迹级别的信用分配；2) 设计正确性监督的停止头，通过结果奖励优化将其细化为可变视野策略。
AI.result: 在连续和软思考设置下，SLPO提升了并行采样下的Pass@k指标，并能将更长的潜在计算分配给更难的实例，同时保持更高的确定性准确率。
AI.conclusion: SLPO成功将结果奖励强化学习引入潜在推理器，实现了潜在测试时扩展，使潜在推理器能够像显式CoT一样通过强化学习超越模仿学习阶段。

title: VQ-Transplant: Efficient VQ-Module Integration for Pre-trained Visual Tokenizers
summary: Vector Quantization (VQ) underpins modern discrete visual tokenization. However, training quantization modules for state-of-the-art VQ-based models requires significant computational resources which, in practice, all but prevents the development of novel, cutting-edge VQ techniques under resource constraints. To address this limitation, we propose {\bf VQ-Transplant}, a simple framework that enables plug-and-play integration of new VQ modules into frozen, pre-trained tokenizers by replacing their native VQ modules. Crucially, the proposed transplantation process preserves all encoder-decoder parameters, obviating the need for costly end-to-end retraining when modifying the quantization method. To mitigate decoder-quantization mismatch, we introduce a lightweight decoder adaptation strategy (trained for only 5 epochs on ImageNet-1k) to align feature priors with the new quantization space. In our empirical evaluation, we find that VQ-Transplant allows obtaining near state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity for industry-level models like VAR while reducing the training cost by 95\%. VQ-Transplant democratizes quantization research by enabling resource-efficient integration of novel VQ techniques while matching industry-level reconstruction performance.

AI.tldr: VQ-Transplant 提出了一种即插即用框架，能够在冻结的预训练分词器中替换向量量化模块，仅需微调解码器5个周期即可实现接近业界水平的重建性能，训练成本降低95%。
AI.motivation: 现有VQ-based模型训练量化模块计算资源消耗巨大，限制了资源受限条件下新型VQ技术的发展。
AI.method: 提出VQ-Transplant框架，冻结编码器-解码器参数，仅替换原生VQ模块为新的VQ模块；引入轻量级解码器适应策略（在ImageNet-1k上仅训练5个周期）以缓解解码器与量化空间之间的不匹配。
AI.result: 在VAR等业界级模型上获得接近最优的重建保真度，训练成本降低95%。
AI.conclusion: VQ-Transplant能够以资源高效的方式集成新型VQ技术，同时匹配业界级别的重建性能，推动了量化研究的民主化。

title: Information Discernment in Large Language Models
summary: LLMs are increasingly used with external knowledge sources like the internet. Do they weigh information appropriately -- updating more for reliable sources (source discernment) and more when claims bring priors closer to the truth (truth discernment)? We formalize this as information discernment and introduce Learn2Discern (L2D), an experimental framework and benchmark grounded in three normative axioms with interpretable metrics. To establish external validity, a pre-registered, quota-matched user study (n=299) confirms that real LLM users endorse all three axioms and report that violations reduce their trust and usage intent. Across 13 models and nearly 670K trials, we find consistent failures across both dimensions: models perform near chance on source and truth discernment, rely on source popularity twice as much as source reliability, and update roughly equally whether a claim improves or worsens their position relative to the ground truth. Models integrate external knowledge most effectively on datasets where their priors are already the most accurate. Newer and larger models improve truth discernment but not source discernment, a blind spot that model complexity does not address. We identify simple inference-time interventions that improve both forms of discernment. We release our dataset and survey as a testbed for a core alignment property that scales in importance as LLMs replace traditional search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息辨别力（Information Discernment）概念，构建Learn2Discern（L2D）框架和基准，通过三项规范性公理评估LLM在整合外部知识时对来源和事实的辨别能力。实验发现模型在来源和事实辨别上接近随机水平，过度依赖来源流行度而非可靠性，且更新幅度与事实正误无关。更大更新的模型改善了事实辨别但未改善来源辨别。研究还提出了简单的推理时干预方法。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地使用互联网等外部知识源，但尚不清楚它们是否能恰当评估信息来源的可靠性（来源辨别）以及信息是否让先验知识更接近真相（事实辨别），这构成了模型与人类价值观对齐的关键问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义了信息辨别力，提出L2D框架，包含三项规范性公理（来源可靠性、事实准确性、一致性更新）及可解释指标。通过预注册的配额匹配用户研究（n=299）验证公理的用户认可度，并对13个模型进行近67万次试验评估。
AI.result: 模型在来源和事实辨别上接近随机水平；来源流行度的影响是可靠性的两倍；模型对改善先验和恶化先验的信息更新幅度几乎相同；外部知识整合在模型先验已准确的数据集上最有效；更大更新的模型改善了事实辨别但未改善来源辨别。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM存在严重的来源和事实辨别缺陷，模型复杂度无法解决来源辨别的盲点，但简单的推理时干预可以改善。随着LLM取代传统搜索，这一对齐属性将变得更加重要。

title: NEXUS: Structured Runtime Safety for Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly execute high-impact actions, making runtime safety monitoring essential. We present NEXUS (Neural EXecution Utility and Safety), a structured-plan safety monitor that applies a formal intervention policy to select among four actions: allow, block, request confirmation, or request revision. NEXUS combines deterministic safety rules, argument-level inspection, and a calibrated logistic-regression risk score for graded escalation. On a 128-instance synthetic benchmark, NEXUS achieves an F1 score of 0.949 and a 4-class intervention accuracy of 0.6406, outperforming rule-only intervention selection by 27.3 percentage points. It also improves over rule-only on R-Judge (F1 = 0.861 vs. 0.849), matches rule-only on AgentHarm due to threat-model limits, and achieves 0% ASR at 99% control allow on IPI. On the rule-blind NEXUS-Stress benchmark, NEXUS reaches an F1 score of 0.881, highlighting the difficulty of fine-grained intervention routing. With 0.205 ms median latency, NEXUS adds under 0.1% overhead to typical agent loops. Code, benchmarks, and the calibrated risk scorer are publicly released.

AI.tldr: NEXUS是一种结构化计划安全监控器，通过结合确定性规则、参数级检查和校准的逻辑回归风险评分，对LLM Agent的执行动作进行分级干预（允许、阻止、请求确认、请求修订），在多个基准上优于纯规则方法，且延迟极低。
AI.motivation: 随着使用工具的LLM Agent执行高风险操作越来越普遍，运行时安全监控变得至关重要，现有方法缺乏精细化的分级干预机制。
AI.method: NEXUS采用形式化干预策略，在四种动作（允许、阻止、请求确认、请求修订）中选择；结合确定性安全规则、参数级检查和校准的Logistic回归风险评分，实现分级升级响应。
AI.result: 在128实例合成基准上F1=0.949，4类干预准确率0.6406（比纯规则高27.3pp）；R-Judge上F1=0.861 vs 0.849；IPI上0% ASR at 99%控制允许；NEXUS-Stress上F1=0.881；中位延迟0.205ms，开销低于0.1%。
AI.conclusion: NEXUS在保证极低延迟和可控性的前提下，显著提升了LLM Agent运行时安全监控的精细度和有效性，代码和基准已公开。

title: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
summary: As large language models and AI agents become the primary consumers of search results, document set quality determines the upper bound of downstream generation. Yet existing evaluation systems remain confined to scoring documents independently and aggregating via nDCG, ignoring inter-document interactions (redundancy, conflict, complementarity) and unable to answer what makes one document set better than another. To address these issues, we propose a complete evaluate-diagnose-optimize framework. We design SetwiseEvalKit, a three-level, nine-dimension document set evaluation benchmark covering both short-form and long-form scenarios, comprising approximately 28K high-quality evaluation rubrics. We systematically evaluate 12 rerankers: even the best method achieves no more than 45% coverage, cross-document coordination dimensions are universally weak, and no single method maintains top performance across both settings. Building on this, we propose Rubric4Setwise, a training-free method that converts rubric-based evaluation criteria into document set selection signals, achieving the best downstream generation performance with fewer documents and search rounds. It is the only method that maintains state-of-the-art results across both scenarios, validating the effectiveness of closing the loop from evaluation to optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套包含评估、诊断和优化三个阶段的文档集质量框架，设计了SetwiseEvalKit基准（三级九维、约28K评估标准），系统评估12种重排序器后发现跨文档协调维度普遍薄弱，进而提出无需训练的Rubric4Setwise方法，通过将评估标准转化为文档选择信号，用更少的文档和搜索轮次实现了最优的下游生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有评估系统仅独立评分文档并通过nDCG聚合，忽略了文档间的冗余、冲突和互补等交互关系，无法回答"什么使一个文档集优于另一个"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 提出evaluate-diagnose-optimize完整框架：1）SetwiseEvalKit：三级九维文档集评估基准（含约28K高质量评估标准）；2）系统评估12种重排序器；3）Rubric4Setwise：将基于rubric的评估标准转化为文档集选择信号的训练无关方法。
AI.result: 最佳重排序方法覆盖率不超过45%；跨文档协调维度普遍表现弱；无单一方法在两种场景下均保持顶尖性能；Rubric4Setwise用更少文档和搜索轮次实现最优下游生成性能，且是唯一在短文本和长文本两种场景均达到SOTA的方法。
AI.conclusion: 从评估到优化的闭环是有效的，Rubric4Setwise验证了将评估标准直接用于文档集优化的可行性，为AI agent和LLM驱动的搜索场景提供了更高效的文档集选择方案。

title: Stochastic Primal-Dual Decoding for Multiobjective Generative Recommender Systems
summary:
Recent advances in recommender systems (RS) have shown substantial performance gains through generative modelling. In practice, recommendation often involves constructing slates -- ordered lists of items -- that must satisfy multiple objectives beyond relevance, such as constraints defined over item attributes or fairness constraints. Existing multiobjective approaches either rely on post-processing techniques designed for non-generative settings, or incorporate auxiliary objectives directly into model training. The former does not explicitly account for the sequential nature of generative RS, while the latter is often impractical in large-scale systems.
  We propose a lightweight, inference-time decoding layer that augments autoregressive generative RS to support multiobjective slate generation without modifying or retraining the underlying model. We formulate decoding as an online constrained optimisation problem, where items are selected sequentially, and trade-offs between relevance and auxiliary objectives are adjusted dynamically based on the remaining constraint slack, i.e., how much of each objective remains to be satisfied. This is implemented via a stochastic primal-dual approximation scheme that balances relevance and auxiliary objectives during generation.
  We provide theoretical guarantees on constraint violation and regret, and evaluate the proposed approach through extensive offline experiments and a large-scale online A/B experiment in a real-world recommender system. Our results show consistent improvements in multiobjective trade-offs, including a +1.8\% gain in the auxiliary objectives achieved at zero cost to user satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级的推理时解码层，通过在线约束优化和随机原始-对偶近似，在不重新训练模型的前提下，使自回归生成式推荐系统支持多目标序列生成。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统需同时满足相关性、属性约束和公平性等多重目标，但现有方法要么仅适用于非生成式场景（后处理），要么需修改模型训练（不实用），缺乏适配生成式推荐序列特性的轻量级解决方案。
AI.method: 提出推理时解码层，将解码过程建模为在线约束优化问题，基于剩余约束松弛量动态调整相关性与辅助目标的权衡，采用随机原始-对偶近似方案实现。
AI.result: 离线实验与大规模在线A/B实验均显示多目标权衡持续改进，辅助目标提升+1.8%，且用户满意度零损失。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需重新训练模型即可有效支持生成式推荐的多目标序列生成，理论上有约束违反和遗憾保证，实践中实现了零成本的多目标改善。

title: Learning the Arabic Dialect Continuum as a Continuous Space: A Regression Approach to Speaker Origin Prediction
summary: We present a regression-based approach to Arabic dialect geolocation that models dialectal variation as a continuous geographic space rather than discrete categories. Speaker origin is predicted as continuous latitude-longitude coordinates using a hierarchical neural architecture that fuses frame-level XLS-R-300M and Whisper-large-v3 encoder representations with phonotactic descriptors through a Transformer encoder and a learnable attention-pooled query. A spherical geodesic loss directly optimizes great-circle distance on Earth's surface, avoiding distortions inherent to planar coordinate regression. Under a leakage-free 5-fold GroupKFold protocol grouped by source recording, our model attains a pooled median localization error of 481.2 km. Auxiliary country and city heads reach 64.5% and 45.2% accuracy, respectively. A permutation Mantel test on the learned latent space provides quantitative support for the Arabic dialect continuum hypothesis. To probe true generalization, we further introduce a city-masking protocol in which two cities per fold are removed from training but retained in validation. Under this zero-shot regime, the mean error rises to 1173.3 km, a 1.32x degradation relative to seen cities. Our findings establish continuous geographic modeling as a principled framework for Arabic dialect geolocation and quantify both its strengths and the substantial headroom that remains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于回归的阿拉伯方言地理定位方法，将方言变异建模为连续地理空间，使用分层神经架构融合多种语音表征，通过球面测地线损失优化，在泄漏可控的实验设置下达到481.2 km的中位定位误差，并通过置换曼特尔检验支持了阿拉伯方言连续体假说。
AI.motivation: 传统阿拉伯方言地理定位将方言视为离散类别，忽略了方言在空间中连续渐变的特点。作者希望建立一种连续地理建模框架，更真实地反映方言的地理分布规律。
AI.method: 采用分层神经架构，融合XLS-R-300M和Whisper-large-v3的帧级编码表示与音位描述符，通过Transformer编码器和可学习的注意力池化查询，预测说话者起源的连续经纬度坐标，使用球面测地线损失（直接优化球面大圆距离）进行训练。
AI.result: 在无泄漏的5折GroupKFold协议下，模型达到481.2 km的中位定位误差；辅助国家和城市分类头分别达到64.5%和45.2%的准确率；零样本城市掩码协议下平均误差升至1173.3 km，性能退化1.32倍。
AI.conclusion: 连续地理建模是阿拉伯方言地理定位的一个有原则性的框架，研究量化了其优势与尚存的改进空间，并通过置换曼特尔检验支持了阿拉伯方言连续体假说。

title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in long chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 have led to increasingly longer inference context lengths under the test-time scaling paradigm. However, the O(n^2) computational complexity of standard self-attention causes inference costs to grow sharply with long sequences, limiting the deployment of long-CoT reasoning in production settings. To address this, we propose LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play attention replacement module that requires no pretraining from scratch. LISA integrates two lightweight components in parallel within the original model: (1) a Linear Attention module that provides long-range memory with O(n) time complexity; (2) a Lightning Indexer that selects the top-M important tokens from the full context to feed into a Sparse Self-Attention. The two branches are fused via a gating mechanism, reducing inference complexity from O(n^2) to O(nM) (M << n) for generating n tokens. We design a two-stage training pipeline: Stage 1 initializes the model by integrating the linear attention to capture long-range dependencies, complemented by a sliding-window attention mechanism that is optimized via knowledge distillation to approximate the full self-attention distribution of a frozen teacher model. In Stage 2, we further introduce the Indexer to replace the static sliding-window mechanism, enabling dynamic token selection from broader contexts. The Indexer is trained using a novel per-head KL divergence loss, which aligns its selection behavior with the attention patterns of the teacher model. Experiments on DeepSeek-distilled-Qwen models demonstrate that LISA achieves a 50% inference speedup under 16K-token context, while improving average performance by 5.6% on reasoning benchmarks including AIME and MATH-500.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LISA（线性索引稀疏注意力），一种即插即用的注意力替换模块，通过并行集成线性注意力（O(n)复杂度）和闪电索引器（动态选择top-M重要token），将推理复杂度从O(n²)降至O(nM)。采用两阶段训练：阶段1通过知识蒸馏训练线性注意力+滑动窗口机制，阶段2引入索引器替代滑动窗口。在DeepSeek蒸馏Qwen模型上，16K上下文下实现50%推理加速，推理基准平均提升5.6%。
AI.motivation: 长链思维推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1）在测试时扩展范式下推理上下文长度不断增加，但标准自注意力的O(n²)计算复杂度导致长序列推理成本急剧增长，限制了长CoT推理在生产环境中的部署。
AI.method: LISA包含两个并行轻量组件：1）线性注意力模块（O(n)复杂度）提供长程记忆；2）闪电索引器从完整上下文中选择top-M重要token输入稀疏自注意力。两分支通过门控机制融合。两阶段训练：阶段1通过知识蒸馏优化线性注意力+滑动窗口；阶段2引入索引器，使用逐头KL散度损失对齐教师模型的注意力模式。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek蒸馏Qwen模型上，16K上下文下实现50%推理加速，同时在AIME和MATH-500等推理基准上平均性能提升5.6%。
AI.conclusion: LISA有效解决了长CoT推理中的计算效率瓶颈，在不需从头预训练的前提下，通过即插即用的方式大幅降低推理复杂度，同时保持甚至提升推理性能，为长序列推理模型的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: TriAgent: Divergence-Aware Multi-Agent Committees for Cost-Efficient Financial Sentiment Analysis
summary: Production LLM-based financial sentiment analysis faces a structural cost trap: most queries are trivially classifiable, yet expensive cloud reasoners process them all, and the bill scales linearly with user count. We present TriAgent, a multi-agent committee stratified by contextual granularity -- a word-level lexicon (VADER), a sentence-level domain transformer (FinBERT), and a cross-sentence reasoner (Qwen2.5, 0.5B-14B-4bit, with Mistral-7B and Phi-3.5-mini cross-family checks). A three-way Semantic Divergence Index (SDI) measures pairwise disagreement across granularities and routes each query accordingly. Our central finding is the critic plateau: when the LLM is re-tasked as a critic over the smaller agents' outputs, F1 plateaus at ~0.87 across 1.5B-7B Qwen (bootstrap 95% CIs overlap), while a same-size 3-persona vote drops to F1=0.66, which is driven by granularity-stratified diversity. Three corollaries follow from the same SDI signal: (i) a Shared Consensus Dictionary on multilingual sentence-BERT answers 95% of Chinese queries from an English cache at F1=0.99 -- cross-border canonicalization at zero marginal cost; (ii) SDI doubles as a post-hoc LLM-hallucination detector at AUC=0.90; (iii) the SDI single-stage strategy attains the best risk-adjusted return (Sharpe=3.50) on a 20-ticker back-test, dominating both always-FinBERT (1.36) and always-LLM (0.11). At 10M-user scale, TriAgent saves $9.3M/year vs. a GPT-4o-mini baseline. Code, lexicons, and the SCD are released.

AI.tldr: TriAgent通过三级粒度（词级VADER、句级FinBERT、跨句LLM）的语义分歧指数（SDI）路由查询，实现低成本高精度金融情感分析，在千万用户规模下年省930万美元，F1达~0.87，并意外发现SDI可兼任幻觉检测器（AUC=0.90）和跨语言缓存（中文查询英文缓存F1=0.99）。
AI.motivation: 现有生产级LLM金融情感分析存在结构性成本陷阱：大多数查询简单可分类，但全部交由昂贵云端推理器处理，成本随用户数线性增长，亟需一种根据查询复杂度动态分配计算资源的方法。
AI.method: 提出TriAgent多智能体委员会，按上下文粒度分层：词级VADER、句级FinBERT、跨句LLM（Qwen2.5 0.5B-14B-4bit等）。设计三维语义分歧指数（SDI）衡量跨粒度两两分歧度，据此路由查询。核心创新：将LLM重新定位为小模型输出的评论员（critic），而非直接投票。
AI.result: LLM作为评论员时F1在1.5B-7B Qwen上稳定在~0.87（bootstrap 95% CI重叠）；同等规模3角色投票仅F1=0.66。SDI作为幻觉检测器AUC=0.90；共享共识字典（SCD）使中文查询命中英文缓存达F1=0.99；20只股票回测中SDI单阶段策略夏普比率3.50，优于始终FinBERT（1.36）和始终LLM（0.11）。千万用户规模年省930万美元。
AI.conclusion: 基于粒度分歧的路由策略可有效打破LLM成本陷阱，SDI是多功能信号（路由+幻觉检测+跨语言缓存），评论员机制比直接投票更高效且鲁棒，代码和词典已开源。

title: A Unified Variational Framework for Deep Weakly Supervised Image Segmentation
summary: We propose a unified variational framework for image segmentation under sparse pixel-level supervision. Our method is based on a simplex-constrained Potts model with a smooth perimeter regularizer, yielding a convex, smooth energy functional that can be used as a training loss in weakly supervised deep learning paradigms or optimized efficiently using iterative methods. Sparse labels are incorporated into the data fidelity term by constructing a fuzzy membership function via a function extension problem in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS), which can effectively capture inhomogeneous intensity statistics. The derived discrete loss for training standard networks demonstrates robustness and consistent improvements over non-training and partial cross-entropy (PCE) baselines in experiments, achieving comparable performance without requiring ground-truth segmentation images.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一的变分框架，利用稀疏像素级监督进行图像分割，基于单纯形约束的Potts模型与光滑周长正则化，构建凸且光滑的能量函数作为弱监督深度学习训练损失，并通过RKHS函数扩展处理稀疏标签。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督图像分割方法难以有效处理稀疏标签和不均匀强度统计，且缺乏统一的理论框架来融合稀疏监督与深度学习。
AI.method: 1) 采用单纯形约束Potts模型与光滑周长正则化，构造凸光滑能量泛函；2) 通过RKHS函数扩展构建模糊隶属函数以捕获不均匀强度统计；3) 将稀疏标签融入数据保真项；4) 导出离散损失用于标准网络训练。
AI.result: 在实验中，该方法相比非训练基线和部分交叉熵(PCE)基线表现出鲁棒性和一致的改进，无需真实分割图像即可达到可比的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该变分框架为弱监督图像分割提供了统一且有效的解决方案，能够在不依赖完整标注的情况下实现高质量分割。

title: Profile-Graph Memory for LLM Agents: Implicit Cross-Entity Traversal through Narrative Profiles
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and MemHop benchmark: https://github.com/ShengtongZhu/ProGraph
summary: Long-term memory is essential for LLM agents that interact across sessions, yet current memory benchmarks primarily evaluate single-hop recall, leaving multi-hop association largely unmeasured. We make three contributions. First, we introduce MemHop, a multi-hop memory benchmark of 1,000 questions at hop depths 1-5 across 10 social-network scenarios, with per-hop evidence annotations. Second, we present Profile-Graph Memory (ProGraph), a two-layer memory architecture combining (i) profile expansion -- substring-matched traversal of entity names that naturally appear in LLM-written profile narratives, a minimal alternative to explicit knowledge-graph construction -- and (ii) compression residuals -- exact dates, quantities, and named items co-extracted with each profile update at zero extra API cost. Third, a full-grid ablation shows cross-benchmark mechanism specialization: profile expansion drives multi-hop reasoning (-22.6pp on MemHop when removed) while compression residuals drive precision recall (-8.6pp on LoCoMo when not co-extracted), with cross-effects under 3pp within a single architecture. ProGraph averages 80.1% on MemHop (matching the FullContext reference) and 78.4% on LoCoMo (exceeding FullContext by 11.3pp), outperforming Mem0, A-Mem, HippoRAG, and RAG on both. We release MemHop, ProGraph, and baseline implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多跳记忆基准MemHop（1000道题，1-5跳）和双层记忆架构ProGraph（轮廓扩展+压缩残差），在MemHop上达80.1%，LoCoMo上78.4%，超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准主要评估单跳召回，缺乏对多跳关联能力的衡量。
AI.method: 双层记忆架构：(1) 轮廓扩展——基于子串匹配的实体名遍历（无需显式知识图谱）；(2) 压缩残差——零额外API成本下共同提取精确日期、数量和命名项。
AI.result: ProGraph在MemHop上80.1%（匹配全上下文基准），LoCoMo上78.4%（超全上下文基准11.3pp），优于Mem0、A-Mem、HippoRAG和RAG。
AI.conclusion: 轮廓扩展驱动多跳推理，压缩残差驱动精确召回，两者在同一架构中交叉效应小于3pp。

title: VizRAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Hypergraph Visualization
summary: Hypergraph-based RAG systems surpass traditional graph-based approaches by organizing complex n-ary atomic facts among entities, rather than relying solely on binary relationships. Despite the advancements in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with enhanced visual capabilities, current hypergraph-based RAG frameworks predominantly restrict knowledge retrieval and reconstruction to a unimodal, text-centric paradigm. This limitation prevents them from fully leveraging the powerful visual perception capabilities of modern MLLMs. To address this gap, we systematically explore the integration of hypergraph awareness in RAG systems through visual cues. By incorporating visual representations of hypergraphs into the RAG pipeline, we introduce VizRAG, the first RAG system to support visual hypergraph structure awareness. Experimental results demonstrate that VizRAG significantly outperforms strong baselines, validating the promising potential of hypergraph visualization as a novel approach for RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VizRAG，首个支持视觉超图结构感知的RAG系统，通过将超图的可视化表示融入RAG流程，超越传统基于文本的超图RAG方法，实验表明其显著优于强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有超图RAG系统仅局限于文本中心范式，未能利用现代多模态大模型强大的视觉感知能力，存在模态局限性。
AI.method: 将超图的视觉表示融入RAG流程，通过可视化超图结构来增强知识检索与重建过程，提出VizRAG系统。
AI.result: VizRAG在实验中显著优于多个强基线模型，验证了超图可视化作为RAG系统新方法的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 超图可视化是一种有前景的RAG系统新范式，能够有效利用多模态大模型的视觉能力，突破传统文本中心限制。

title: PhenSPINE: A Standardized Benchmark for Spine Pathology Diagnosis
comment: 12 pages, figures, Accepted at CITA 2026 (The 15th Conference on Information Technology and its Applications, Scopus)
summary: The accurate diagnosis of spinal pathologies depends heavily on radiological interpretation, yet automated systems are hindered by the lack of diverse, high-quality benchmarks. In this study, we present PhenSPINE, a Magnetic Resonance Imaging dataset comprising 16,813 images from 250 patients, curated to facilitate advanced deep learning research. We propose a robust diagnostic benchmark that integrates state-of-theart convolutional backbones with a Positional Encoding mechanism to explicitly model the anatomical context of intervertebral discs. Evaluating across four standard MRI sequences, our experiments demonstrate that the Sagittal T2-weighted sequence offers the most robust diagnostic value, achieving a superior Macro F1-score of 50.31%. We find that multisequence fusion strategies yield inferior performance compared to this single-sequence baseline, as the images across sequences in our dataset are significantly compromised by noise interference from surrounding anatomical regions. This work establishes a robust baseline and offers critical insights into sequence selection for spine analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhenSPINE数据集（16,813张MRI图像），结合位置编码机制构建脊柱诊断基准，发现Sagittal T2序列表现最佳（Macro F1=50.31%），多序列融合因噪声干扰反而不如单序列。
AI.motivation: 现有自动脊柱诊断系统因缺乏多样化、高质量的基准数据集而受限。
AI.method: 构建PhenSPINE数据集（250名患者，16,813张MRI图像），采用先进卷积骨干网络结合位置编码机制建模椎间盘的解剖上下文，在四种标准MRI序列上评估。
AI.result: Sagittal T2加权序列表现最优（Macro F1=50.31%）；多序列融合策略因图像受周围解剖区域噪声干扰，性能低于单序列基线。
AI.conclusion: 建立了鲁棒的脊柱诊断基线，为序列选择提供了关键见解，指出了多序列融合在当前数据集下的局限性。

title: Lifted Representation Hypothesis in Language Models
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, ICML 2026 Workshop: Philosophy Meets Machine Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often answer queries by mapping individual observations to more general rule-like structures. However, it remains unclear how these structures are stored, selected, and revised. To study this process, we propose thelifted representation hypothesis: LLMs update memory through shared latent structures rather than isolated instance-level facts. This view frames lifting as an efficient use of symmetry across instances, and shattering as the refinement of coarse lifted structures into more specific subtypes. We evaluate LLMs' lifting and shattering through controlled exception-learning experiments across in-context learning, LoRA, and full fine-tuning. We find that LLMs are vulnerable to shattering failures when data are governed by nested rules and exceptions, while lifting often occurs prematurely. These results highlight the need to study the relation between data and rule structures in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"提升表征假说"，研究LLM如何通过共享潜在结构（而非孤立事实）存储、选择和修正规则，并通过实验发现LLM在嵌套规则与例外数据中容易过早提升或破碎失败。
AI.motivation: 现有研究不清楚LLM如何将个体观察映射为类规则结构，以及这些结构如何存储、选择和修正，因此需要系统性理论框架来解释这一过程。
AI.method: 提出提升表征假说，将提升定义为跨实例对称性的高效利用，破碎定义为粗粒度结构细化为子类型；通过受控的例外学习实验，在上下文学习、LoRA和全量微调三种设置下评估LLM的表现。
AI.result: 发现LLM在数据受嵌套规则和例外支配时容易发生破碎失败，同时提升往往过早发生。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明需要关注数据与规则结构之间的关系，LLM的规则学习存在系统性缺陷。

title: D2VBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Value Dilemmas in Daily Scenarios
summary: With the wide application of large language models (LLMs) in real-world scenarios, the value implication of their outputs is crucial. However, existing evaluation benchmarks suffer from insufficient coverage of value dilemmas in daily scenarios involving multiple value conflicts and simplistic evaluation formalisms that fail to assess LLMs' value alignment. To address these issues, we propose D2VBench, a value alignment benchmark comprising 10,000 instances of real daily dilemma scenarios constructed through a multi-stage collaboration between LLMs and humans, grounded in 158 manually annotated fine-grained value concepts. For evaluation on the benchmark, we present a hybrid evaluation paradigm that integrates multiple-choice questions with open-ended questions. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on eight mainstream LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that D2VBench exhibits high reliability and robustness, effectively reflecting the LLMs' alignment across different value categories and dimensions, and providing a more realistic and fine-grained tool for research on value alignment. The dataset is available at https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/D2VBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D2VBench，一个包含10,000个日常困境场景的价值对齐基准，通过多阶段人机协作构建，基于158个细粒度价值概念，并结合多项选择与开放问题的混合评估范式，对8个主流LLM进行综合评测。
AI.motivation: 现有评估基准存在两个问题：日常场景中多价值冲突的覆盖不足，以及评估形式过于简单，无法有效评估LLM的价值对齐能力。
AI.method: 通过LLM与人类的多阶段协作，基于158个细粒度价值概念构建10,000个真实日常困境实例；提出混合评估范式，融合多项选择题与开放性问题。
AI.result: 在8个主流LLM上的实验表明，D2VBench具有高可靠性和鲁棒性，能有效反映模型在不同价值类别和维度上的对齐情况。
AI.conclusion: D2VBench为价值对齐研究提供了更真实、更细粒度的评估工具。

title: SafeGen: Goal-Conditioned Video Diffusion of Safety-Critical Scenarios for VLM-Based Autonomous Driving
summary: VLMs are increasingly deployed in AD systems, creating an urgent need for rigorous safety evaluation under rare yet safety-critical scenarios. Among these, interactions with vulnerable road users represent a major source of real-world failures. However, existing safety-critical scenario generation methods predominantly rely on simulator-based pipelines, which suffer from a substantial sim-to-real gap and often fail to capture realistic, diverse, and unforeseen human-vehicle interaction dynamics. We present SafeGen, a goal-conditioned diffusion framework for safety-critical scenario generation in VLMADs. Our key insight is to formulate scenario generation as a goal-conditioned diffusion process, where a predefined catastrophic end-state serves as a strong supervisory signal, guiding the generation of temporally coherent video trajectories that naturally evolve toward safety-critical outcomes. Building on this formulation, we introduce Context Grounded End State Reasoning, which leverages VLMs to analyze benign driving contexts and infer latent vulnerabilities in human-vehicle interactions, producing structured end-state specifications that induce high-risk scenarios. Conditioned on these targets, we further propose End State Conditioned Video Evolution, which grounds semantic threats into physically plausible visual dynamics. Specifically, we instantiate high-risk agents within the scene via depth-aware geometric projection, followed by boundary-conditioned diffusion to generate intermediate frames with consistent motion patterns and temporal coherence. Extensive experiments across 3 VLMADs demonstrate that SafeGen increases the Judge Overall Score, a metric using a VLM judge to evaluate VLMADs' understanding and decision-making, by 24.25% on average compared to SoTA baselines. Furthermore, fine-tuning a VLMAD improves performance in real-world driving scenes by an average of 15.9%.

AI.tldr: SafeGen是一个基于目标条件扩散框架的安全关键场景生成方法，用于评估视觉语言模型自动驾驶系统（VLMADs）。通过将场景生成建模为目标条件扩散过程，利用预定义的灾难性终态作为监督信号，生成自然演变为安全关键结果的视频轨迹。实验表明，该方法在VLMAD评估指标上平均提升24.25%，微调后真实驾驶场景性能提升15.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有安全关键场景生成方法主要依赖模拟器管线，存在严重的模拟到真实差距（sim-to-real gap），难以捕获真实、多样且不可预见的人-车交互动态，亟需在真实世界场景下对VLMADs进行严格的安全评估。
AI.method: 1) 将场景生成建模为目标条件扩散过程，以灾难性终态作为监督信号生成时间连贯的视频轨迹。2) 引入上下文接地终态推理（Context Grounded End State Reasoning），利用VLM分析良性驾驶上下文并推断潜在风险，生成结构化终态规范。3) 提出终态条件视频演化（End State Conditioned Video Evolution），通过深度感知几何投影实例化高风险智能体，并采用边界条件扩散生成中间帧。
AI.result: 在3个VLMADs上进行大量实验，SafeGen相比最先进基线在Judge Overall Score上平均提升24.25%；使用生成数据微调VLMAD后，真实驾驶场景性能平均提升15.9%。
AI.conclusion: SafeGen有效弥合了模拟到真实的差距，生成的多样且高风险场景能显著提升VLMADs的安全评估能力，同时通过微调可改善模型在真实驾驶场景中的表现。

title: GraphContainer: A Unified Platform for Comparing and Debugging Graph RAG Methods
summary: Graph RAG mitigates hallucinations and stale knowledge in LLMs, particularly for multi-hop question answering. However, existing approaches remain highly fragmented and incompatible. The structural heterogeneity of graph formats across different frameworks and the lack of granular visualization tools make it exceedingly difficult to evaluate and compare retrieval behaviors. To bridge this gap, we propose GraphContainer, a novel platform designed to unify and visualize diverse graph RAG workflows. GraphContainer features two key components: (1) a Unified Graph Representation (UGR) layer that seamlessly standardizes multi-format graphs, and (2) a Graph Recorder that tracks and visually renders the step-by-step retrieval process. Through an interactive web interface, we demonstrate GraphContainer's ability to import heterogeneous graphs and perform live, traceable visual debugging of graph RAG methods. Ultimately, we show how GraphContainer enables controlled comparisons of various graph formats and retrieval strategies, lowering the barrier for researchers and practitioners to design optimal graph RAG pipelines. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/O02eNJLwkU0.

AI.tldr: GraphContainer是一个统一和可视化图RAG工作流的平台，包含统一图表示层和图记录器两个关键组件，支持多格式图导入和逐步检索过程可视化，便于研究人员比较不同图格式和检索策略。
AI.motivation: 现有图RAG方法高度碎片化且不兼容，不同框架的图格式结构异构，缺乏细粒度可视化工具，导致难以评估和比较检索行为。
AI.method: 提出GraphContainer平台，包含两个核心组件：(1) 统一图表示层，标准化多格式图；(2) 图记录器，追踪并可视渲染逐步检索过程。通过交互式Web界面实现异构图导入和实时可视化调试。
AI.result: 成功展示了异构图导入能力以及图RAG方法的实时可追溯可视化调试，实现了不同图格式和检索策略的受控比较。
AI.conclusion: GraphContainer降低了研究人员和实践者设计最优图RAG管道的门槛，填补了图RAG统一评估与可视化工具的空白。

title: Sentence Splitter: Uncovering Latent Factual Structure for Self-Supervised Learning
summary: This paper introduces Sentence Splitter, a self-supervised framework built upon a T5-based encoder--decoder architecture for uncovering the latent factual structure of natural language sentences. The proposed method identifies the semantic boundary between a descriptive prefix (head) and its factual completion (tail) by formulating sentence splitting as a discrete segmentation problem, where a sentence of length $N$ admits $N$ possible split points but only one recovers the intended head--tail structure. Rather than explicitly searching over all candidate boundaries, the model learns to recover the factual completion through probabilistic sequence generation. To eliminate the need for manual annotation, symbolic head--tail pairs are first verbalized into natural-language templates that provide supervision for training the Sentence Splitter. The trained splitter is then applied to raw text to extract aligned prefix--tail pairs, which are subsequently used to train a generative model that proposes additional plausible completions through a lightweight bootstrapping process. This unified pipeline provides a scalable and structure-aware approach to constructing self-supervised training data while bridging symbolic knowledge and natural language. Experiments on both structured and naturally occurring text demonstrate that the proposed splitter generalizes beyond synthetic templates and that the resulting structure-aware supervision consistently improves downstream performance on knowledge graph completion and commonsense question answering, highlighting the effectiveness of recovering latent factual structure for knowledge-centric NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sentence Splitter，一个基于T5编码器-解码器的自监督框架，用于发现自然语言句子的潜在事实结构。该方法通过将句子分割建模为离散分割问题，识别描述性前缀（head）与其事实补全（tail）之间的语义边界。模型无需人工标注，通过符号化头-尾对生成自然语言模板进行训练，再应用于原始文本提取对齐的前缀-尾对，最终通过轻量级引导过程训练生成模型。实验表明该方法在知识图谱补全和常识问答等下游任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以自动发现自然语言句子中隐藏的事实结构（如主语-关系-宾语），且缺乏可扩展的自监督训练数据构建方式，需要大量人工标注。
AI.method: 1) 将句子分割建模为离散分割问题，识别前缀（head）与事实补全（tail）的边界；2) 利用T5编码器-解码器架构通过概率序列生成学习分割；3) 将符号化头-尾对verbalize为自然语言模板作为自监督信号；4) 训练好的splitter提取原始文本中的对齐对，再通过引导过程训练生成模型。
AI.result: 在结构化文本和自然文本上均表现良好，能泛化到合成模板之外；在知识图谱补全和常识问答任务上，结构感知的监督信号持续提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展、结构感知的自监督训练数据构建方法，有效桥接了符号知识与自然语言，验证了恢复潜在事实结构对知识中心NLP的有效性。

title: AdaRoPE: Not All Attention Heads Should Rotate and Scale Equally
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is widely adopted in Transformers to encode positional information, yet standard implementations enforce a uniform frequency schedule and scaling across all attention heads. Using simplified retrieval tasks and length generalization scenarios, we show -- both empirically and theoretically -- that heads with different functional roles require distinct frequency ranges and attention scaling factors to operate effectively. Ignoring this structure leads to suboptimal utilization of embedding dimensions and degraded performance, particularly under long-context settings. To address these limitations, we propose AdaRoPE, which equips each attention head with learnable rotation frequencies and attention scaling factors. Pretrained LLMs with AdaRoPE consistently outperform existing RoPE variants, including partial RoPE and NoPE baselines. For context extension, we further show that uniform frequency and attention scaling, used in methods such as YaRN, are suboptimal. By applying head-specific scaling, AdaRoPE enables better context extension while better preserving short-context performance in both the extrapolation setting and the long-context continued pretraining setting. These results highlight the importance of optimizing rotary position embedding at the level of individual attention heads.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaRoPE，为每个注意力头学习独立的旋转频率和缩放因子，替代传统RoPE的统一设置，提升长上下文性能。
AI.motivation: 标准RoPE对所有注意力头使用统一的频率调度和缩放，但不同功能角色的头需要不同的频率范围和缩放因子，导致维度利用不足和性能下降。
AI.method: AdaRoPE为每个注意力头引入可学习的旋转频率和注意力缩放因子，在预训练和长上下文扩展中优化头级别的位置编码。
AI.result: AdaRoPE在预训练LLM中优于部分RoPE和NoPE基线；在上下文扩展中，头特定缩放优于YaRN等统一缩放方法，更好保持短上下文性能。
AI.conclusion: 优化旋转位置编码需要在单个注意力头级别进行，AdaRoPE通过头特定的频率和缩放设计有效提升了长上下文建模能力。

title: emb-diversity: A Tool for Embedding-Based Measurement of Data Diversity
summary: There is growing evidence that data diversity is crucial for developing fair and robust NLP models. However, current approaches to measure diversity remain inconsistent and fragmented: While there exist a number of tools for measuring the lexical diversity of texts, researchers lack standardized tools for quantifying diversity based on embeddings. Embedding-based diversity measures are highly flexible: They work with any embedding model and any data that can be embedded, and are thus applicable to many notions of diversity. With emb-diversity, we provide a comprehensive embedding-based diversity measurement tool, spanning a broad range of measures. We demonstrate its potential for several use cases: measuring the stylistic, semantic, language and speaker diversity of datasets. https://github.com/nlpsoc/emb-diversity/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 emb-diversity，一个基于嵌入的综合性多样性测量工具，可灵活测量文本数据的风格、语义、语言和说话者多样性，填补了标准化嵌入级多样性测量工具的缺失。
AI.motivation: 现有证据表明数据多样性对构建公平和鲁棒的NLP模型至关重要，但目前多样性测量方法零散且不统一：词汇多样性有工具可用，但缺乏标准化的基于嵌入的多样性测量工具。
AI.method: 开发了 emb-diversity 工具，该工具基于嵌入模型实现多种多样性度量，适用于任何可嵌入的数据和嵌入模型，覆盖广泛的多样性测量方法。
AI.result: 该工具可用于测量数据集的风格多样性、语义多样性、语言多样性和说话者多样性等多个用例。
AI.conclusion: emb-diversity 提供了一个灵活、全面的嵌入级多样性测量方案，有望推动NLP数据多样性的标准化评估。

title: Statistically Grounded Sparse-Feature Interventions for Activation-Space Control in Large Language Models
summary: Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for behavioral control of large language models, but SAE-based steering methods often rely on learned steering objectives or single-criterion feature selection. We introduce a transparent SAE-feature steering pipeline that first applies a six-condition reliability filter, then ranks sparse features through an unweighted Borda consensus over three complementary statistics: $F$-test, KSG mutual information, and Cohen's $d$. The resulting steering direction is constructed as a Cohen's-$d$-weighted combination of SAE decoder rows, providing an optimization-free direction motivated by Fisher-LDA under approximate SAE-feature decorrelation. Across three Gemma-family models, four behavioral domains, and 356 layer-strength configurations, the method produces measurable domain-specific shifts while revealing a substantial gap between raw attribute movement and quality-preserving generation. In the strongest configuration, logical-correctness steering reaches a primary-score delta of $+1.16$ in Gemma~2 9B; however, our broader finding is that usable steering is highly localized by model, domain, layer, and strength. These results argue that activation-steering evaluations should report quality-conditioned success alongside raw behavioral shift. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Oshayer-Siddique/LLM-Steering-Using-SAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SAE特征的无优化激活引导管道，通过六条件可靠性过滤和Borda共识排序选择特征，构建引导方向。在多个Gemma模型和领域上验证了有效性，但发现可用引导高度依赖于模型、层和强度，并强调评估应考虑生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于SAE的激活引导方法通常依赖于学习得到的引导目标或单一标准的特征选择，缺乏透明性和可解释性。作者希望提出一种无需优化、透明的特征选择与引导方法。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 六条件可靠性过滤筛选SAE特征；(2) 基于F检验、KSG互信息和Cohen's d三种统计量的无加权Borda共识排序；(3) 利用Cohen's d加权组合SAE解码器行构建引导方向，灵感来自Fisher线性判别分析（Fisher-LDA）。
AI.result: 在三个Gemma模型、四个行为领域、356种层-强度配置上测试，方法产生可测量的领域特定偏移。最强配置下，逻辑正确性引导在Gemma 2 9B上达到+1.16的主分数差值，但可用引导高度依赖于模型、领域、层和强度。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导评估应报告考虑生成质量的受条件限制的成功率，而不仅仅是原始行为偏移。代码和数据已开源。

title: ReFace: Reorganizing Facial Spatiotemporal Representations for Improved Pain Assessment
comment: Accepted at the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
summary: Automatic pain assessment from facial video remains challenging due to the spatial heterogeneity of pain-related facial cues. This study proposes ReFace, a spatial reorganization pipeline that divides facial input into four spatial quadrants before tokenization, rather than processing the entire face as a single region. Evaluated on the AI4Pain dataset, the proposed approach achieves $56.00\%$ accuracy on the test set using video only, achieving the highest reported accuracy under the fixed AI4Pain benchmark protocol among the compared methods. Notably, the four-quadrant configuration processes the same total pixel budget as the full-face input, yet achieves higher accuracy, suggesting that spatial reorganization can improve performance under the proposed tokenization design. A single quadrant region, processing just one quarter of those pixels, remains competitive at a fraction of the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReFace方法，通过将面部图像划分为四个空间象限进行疼痛评估，在AI4Pain数据集上取得56.00%准确率，达到该基准下的最高报告性能，且四象限配置在相同像素预算下优于全脸处理。
AI.motivation: 面部疼痛相关的空间异质性使得从视频中自动评估疼痛具有挑战性，现有方法将整张脸作为一个区域处理，忽略了疼痛线索在面部不同区域的分布差异。
AI.method: ReFace将面部输入在token化之前划分为四个空间象限，分别处理后再进行综合评估，而非直接处理整张人脸。
AI.result: 在AI4Pain数据集上仅使用视频即达到56.00%的测试集准确率，在固定基准协议下高于所有对比方法。四象限配置与全脸输入使用相同像素预算但准确率更高，单象限仅使用四分之一像素仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 空间重组能够有效提升疼痛评估性能，验证了在提出的token化设计下，合理划分面部区域比整体处理更具优势。

title: Logic-Guided Data Extraction with Answer Set Programming and Large Language Models
comment: 42nd International Conference on Logic Programming, to appear in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
summary: When Large Language Models (LLMs) are used for semantic data extraction from unstructured text, producing candidate relational facts from natural language, they may remain unreliable for tasks requiring complex combinatorial reasoning and global consistency. This paper proposes a logic-guided data extraction framework combining LLM-based extraction with Answer Set Programming (ASP). The LLM produces candidate facts, whereas ASP performs validation, inference, consistency checking, and control. Unlike existing pipelines that query the LLM independently for all target predicates, the proposed approach uses ASP reasoning to identify which predicates are logically admissible at each stage and to guide extraction queries. By interleaving LLM calls with ASP derivation, the framework infers logically implied facts without further extraction and detects inconsistencies early. We formalize the pipeline and prove that, under mild assumptions, it is equivalent to the baseline approach with respect to the final extracted facts, while requiring fewer LLM calls. We also introduce a caching mechanism for logic-based control queries, exploiting monotonicity of conjunctive queries over incrementally constructed fact sets to reduce solver invocations. Experiments on ASP-derived benchmarks show that the framework reduces LLM calls and improves extraction quality by mitigating spurious outputs, demonstrating the value of non-monotonic logic programming for controlled semantic extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种逻辑引导的数据抽取框架，将大语言模型（LLM）与回答集编程（ASP）结合，通过ASP进行验证、推理、一致性检查和查询控制，在保证抽取质量的同时减少LLM调用次数。
AI.motivation: LLM在从非结构化文本中抽取语义数据时，对于需要复杂组合推理和全局一致性的任务不可靠，现有流水线方法对所有目标谓词独立查询LLM，效率低且缺乏逻辑约束。
AI.method: 提出LLM+ASP的交互式框架：LLM生成候选事实，ASP负责验证、推理、一致性检查和控制查询；通过ASP推理确定每个阶段逻辑上可接受的谓词，引导抽取查询；采用LLM调用与ASP推导交替进行的方式，利用缓存机制减少求解器调用。
AI.result: 在ASP导出的基准测试上，该框架减少了LLM调用次数，并通过抑制虚假输出提升了抽取质量。
AI.conclusion: 非单调逻辑编程（ASP）在受控语义抽取中具有重要价值，证明了逻辑约束可以有效提升LLM数据抽取的效率和可靠性。

title: Overview of FinMMEval 2026 Task 2: Multilingual Financial Short-Answer Question Answering
comment: 9 pages. Task overview paper for CLEF 2026 Working Notes (CEUR Workshop Proceedings)
summary: FinMMEval 2026 Task 2 evaluates short-answer financial question answering over multilingual evidence. Each final-test item pairs an English question with financial statements and news in English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, and Greek. Participating systems submit one concise answer per item in JSONL format. The final-test set contains 256 items, split evenly between easy and expert tiers; each tier contains four question templates instantiated over 32 company-report groups. Gold answers were withheld during submission, and systems were ranked by macro-averaged item-level ROUGE-1 F1 against organizer-held reference answers. The final leaderboard includes 12 ranked submissions. The strongest systems are closely clustered, with the top four separated by less than one percentage point in ROUGE-1 F1. The submitted system papers document retrieval-augmented generation, cross-lingual evidence handling, structured prompting, answer compression, and validation strategies.

AI.tldr: FinMMEval 2026 Task 2是一个多语言金融短答案问答评测任务，包含256道题（难易各半），涉及英中、日、西、希腊语。12个参赛系统中，前四名ROUGE-1 F1差距不足1%，系统采用RAG、跨语言证据处理、结构化提示等策略。
AI.motivation: 评估多语言环境下金融领域短答案问答能力，推动跨语言金融信息检索与理解的研究。
AI.method: 256道题分为easy和expert两个等级，每个等级4个问题模板，覆盖32个公司报告组。使用ROUGE-1 F1宏平均评分，答案格式为JSONL。
AI.result: 12个提交系统，前四名ROUGE-1 F1差距小于1个百分点，表明高水平系统性能非常接近。
AI.conclusion: 多语言金融问答任务具有挑战性，检索增强生成和跨语言证据处理是有效策略，但顶级系统间的微小差距意味着进一步提升需要更精细的技术突破。

title: Geometry-Guided Constraint Learning for LLM Safety Classification
summary: Safety as Polytope (SaP) learns linear half-space constraints in LLM hidden space but requires per-category tuning of the constraint count K. We show that sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature extraction resolves this: K=2 becomes optimal for 12/14 categories on Qwen3.5-9B, achieving 96-99% accuracy per category on our BeaverTails classification benchmark, largely eliminating the need for exhaustive sweeps (K=4-25 with random initialization). This convergence to two planes is consistent with the Linear Representation Hypothesis, providing suggestive evidence that safety boundaries in this setting admit a low-dimensional linear description in the SAE feature space. Building on this geometric perspective, we introduce a cone constraint whose learnable aperture adapts to each category's cluster concentration, stabilized by a three-phase training

AI.tldr: 本文提出在稀疏自编码器特征空间中，安全边界可简化为两个线性半空间约束（K=2），并引入可学习孔径的锥约束来适应不同类别的聚类分布。
AI.motivation: 原有的SaP方法需要为每个类别手动调优约束数量K（通常需在4-25范围内穷举搜索），效率低下且依赖随机初始化。
AI.method: 利用稀疏自编码器提取特征，将安全约束数量统一设为K=2，并在SAE特征空间中引入锥约束，其孔径可自适应学习，配合三阶段训练策略稳定优化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B模型上，12/14类别在K=2时达到最优，BeaverTails分类基准测试中每类准确率达96-99%，大幅减少搜索开销。
AI.conclusion: 安全边界在SAE特征空间中存在低维线性描述，支持线性表示假说；锥约束方法更适应数据几何结构。

title: Efficient Tracking and Understanding Object Transformations
summary: Tracking objects through state transformations is essential for understanding real-world dynamics. However, existing methods are computationally expensive. TubeletGraph recently showed impressive capabilities, but its inference cost (~$4.4$ seconds per object-frame on VOST) precludes any real-time deployment possibilities. We observe that TubeletGraph's overhead arises from building a spatiotemporal partition of the input video: (1) entity segmentation is computed densely for every frame regardless of whether a transformation occurs, and (2) every entity in the scene is tracked, scaling cost with scene complexity rather than the number of transformations of interest. To address both, we propose FluxGraph, a reactive variant that uses SAM2's internal multi-mask disagreement as a lightweight trigger for transformation detection, and removes the need for tracking all entities in the given video. FluxGraph is ~$3.3\times$ faster than TubeletGraph on VOST while improving tracking performance and preserving state graph quality. Furthermore, we also observe consistent speedups of $3.7-10.7\times$ across VSCOS, M$^3$-VOS, and DAVIS17 while maintaining performance. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/YihongSun/FluxGraph.

AI.tldr: FluxGraph是一种基于SAM2的轻量级视频对象状态变换追踪方法，相比TubeletGraph在VOST上提速3.3倍，在多个数据集上提速3.7-10.7倍，同时保持或提升追踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频对象状态变换追踪方法（如TubeletGraph）推理成本高，无法实现实时部署，主要因为其对每一帧都进行密集实体分割，并追踪场景中所有实体，计算量与场景复杂度成正比。
AI.method: 利用SAM2内部的多掩码不一致性作为轻量级触发器来检测变换发生，避免逐帧密集计算；同时去除追踪所有实体的需求，仅关注感兴趣的变换。
AI.result: 在VOST上提速约3.3倍，性能提升；在VSCOS、M³-VOS、DAVIS17上取得3.7-10.7倍加速，同时保持追踪性能。
AI.conclusion: FluxGraph通过反应式触发机制有效降低了状态变换追踪的计算开销，为实时应用提供了可行方案。

title: Rethinking Uncertainty Evaluation in Large Language Models
