summary: Calibration is the primary criterion for evaluating LLM confidence, but it is insufficient: it admits trivially incoherent estimators, depends on the evaluation distribution, and does not test the extent to which the estimation can be interpreted as a consistent, underlying probability function. What we actually need is for LLM confidence estimates to satisfy the conditions required of coherent probabilistic beliefs. We formalize these conditions along three axes (structural coherence, faithfulness, and usefulness) and operationalize them as the C1 metrics. Widely used estimators systematically violate these conditions despite appearing well-calibrated: models assign lower confidence to logically easier questions 31\% of the time, and common interventions reducing RMSCE leave structural violations unchanged, suggesting that calibration is orthogonal to probabilistic validity. RLHF and chain-of-thought improve usefulness metrics without restoring coherence. Our results show current LLM confidence estimates cannot be interpreted as coherent probabilities; our framework provides the tools to measure and close this gap.

AI.tldr: 论文指出校准不足以评估LLM置信度，提出C1指标衡量结构一致性、忠实性和有用性三个维度的概率一致性，发现现有模型虽表面校准良好但系统性地违反概率一致性条件，RLHF和思维链等干预无法恢复结构性一致性。
AI.motivation: 校准作为LLM置信度的主要评估标准存在不足：它允许平凡不一致的估计、依赖评估分布、且不能测试估计是否可解释为一致的概率函数。我们需要LLM置信度估计满足连贯概率信念所需的条件。
AI.method: 从三个轴（结构一致性、忠实性、有用性）形式化概率连贯条件，并操作化为C1指标，对广泛使用的置信度估计器进行系统评估。
AI.result: 广泛使用的估计器虽表面校准良好但系统性地违反概率连贯条件；模型在31%的情况下对逻辑更简单的问题分配更低置信度；降低RMSCE的常见干预不改变结构违反情况；RLHF和思维链改善有用性指标但未恢复一致性。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM置信度估计不能被解释为连贯概率；所提出的框架提供了衡量和弥合这一差距的工具。

title: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Explainability in Media Bias Detection
summary: Detecting media bias automatically is difficult because biased framing is often subtle, yet in domains such as news analysis, accurate predictions alone are insufficient without explanations that reflect the model's underlying reasoning. We present a multi-dimensional evaluation of explainability in encoder-based media bias detection using the Bias Annotations By Experts (BABE) dataset. Specifically, we study BERT and RoBERTa as classifiers (base and large variants) along three complementary axes: predictive performance, explanation plausibility (token-level alignment with expert rationales), and mechanistic faithfulness (whether compact sets of attention heads recover predictive signal under counterfactual rationale masking). To induce variation in plausibility, we additionally investigate attention-supervised finetuning, which incorporates expert rationale annotations as an auxiliary training signal. Attention supervision serves as an intervention on attribution plausibility, while the effectiveness of attribution methods varies substantially across architectures. Circuit analysis further reveals substantial variation in mechanistic recoverability across architectures, suggesting that model scale alone does not determine circuit compressibility. Taken together, our findings suggest that predictive performance, attribution plausibility, and mechanistic faithfulness characterize different aspects of model behavior and should be evaluated separately when studying explainability in media bias detection.

AI.tldr: 本文在媒体偏见检测中，从预测性能、解释合理性和机制忠实性三个维度系统评估了BERT和RoBERTa模型的可解释性，发现这三个维度刻画了模型行为的不同方面，应分开评估。
AI.motivation: 媒体偏见自动检测中的偏见框架往往微妙，仅靠准确预测不够，还需要能够反映模型推理过程的可解释性。现有研究缺乏对可解释性的多维评估。
AI.method: 使用BABE数据集，以BERT和RoBERTa（base和large变体）为分类器，从三个维度评估：（1）预测性能；（2）解释合理性（token级与专家标注对齐）；（3）机制忠实性（注意力头紧凑集在反事实理性掩码下能否恢复预测信号）。同时引入注意力监督微调作为干预手段。
AI.result: 注意力监督改变了归因合理性，但归因方法的效果因架构而异。电路分析显示不同架构的机制可恢复性存在显著差异，模型规模并非电路可压缩性的决定因素。
AI.conclusion: 预测性能、归因合理性和机制忠实性刻画了模型行为的不同方面，在媒体偏见检测的可解释性研究中应分别评估。

title: Extending a Large View Synthesis Model for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 31 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Project page: https://kwonyoung9120.github.io/PanopticLVSM/
summary: Large view synthesis models synthesize novel views through cross-view attention without explicit 3D representations, and recent studies have shown that they learn accurate spatial correspondence from RGB supervision alone. We observe that this correspondence generalizes beyond appearance. When non-photorealistic signals such as binary encoded panoptic labels are passed through the model, they are propagated to novel views with consistent spatial structure. These results indicate that the correspondence learned for RGB view synthesis can also propagate view-independent per-pixel labels. From this observation, we present the first work to extend large view synthesis models beyond appearance rendering to 3D scene understanding. We propose a panoptic segmentation pipeline that reuses a frozen view synthesis model to propagate panoptic labels from input views to novel views, without 3D reconstruction or any segmentation-specific training of the view synthesis model. Given panoptic labels on the input views, we encode them into binary channel representations and pass them through the same model to render target-view segmentation. On ScanNet, our method achieves segmentation quality on par with Gaussian based approaches requiring explicit 3D reconstruction, while outperforming them in novel view synthesis by more than 7 dB. The label propagation also transfers across datasets, surpassing these approaches on Replica without any fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将大型视图合成模型拓展到3D场景理解领域，提出无需3D重建或分割训练的泛光分割流程，利用冻结的视图合成模型将输入视图的泛光标签通过二进制编码传播到新视图，在ScanNet和Replica上取得了与基于高斯方法相当甚至更优的分割与合成效果。
AI.motivation: 观察到大型视图合成模型通过RGB监督学习的跨视图注意力能够泛化出准确的空间对应关系，且该对应关系可推广到非真实感信号（如二进制编码的泛光标签），希望利用这种能力实现无需3D重建和分割训练的3D场景理解。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结的大型视图合成模型；2) 将输入视图的泛光标签编码为二进制通道表示；3) 将编码后的标签通过同一模型前向传播，渲染出目标视图的分割结果；4) 完全无需3D重建或对视图合成模型进行分割任务的专门训练。
AI.result: 在ScanNet上，分割质量与基于高斯泼溅的显式3D重建方法相当；在新视图合成任务上，PSNR超过这些方法7dB以上。在Replica上无需微调即可跨数据集迁移，性能优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明了大型视图合成模型学到的空间对应关系可以超越外观渲染，有效用于3D场景理解中的标签传播，为无需显式3D重建的场景分割提供了新范式。

title: Spectral-LSH: Sub-Quadratic Prompt Compression via Krylov-Projected Locality-Sensitive Hashing
summary:
Long-prompt inference remains expensive because prefill attention scales quadratically with sequence length. We propose Spectral-LSH, a training-free prompt compression method that operates before the prompt enters the language model. Spectral-LSH approximates the dominant components of an implicit attention-kernel operator using a Krylov subspace method together with random features, avoiding explicit $O(N^2)$ attention-kernel materialization. It then applies SimHash in the resulting attention eigenspace to group similar tokens and aggregate them into macro-tokens with causal positional assignments.
  We evaluate Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on C4. Our experiments reveal a compression-ratio phase transition. Below $ρ= 4 \times$, local token redundancy is low enough that lightweight chunking typically provides the best latency--quality trade-off. Above $ρ= 8 \times$, the spectral path preserves quality that chunking loses. At $ρ= 16 \times$, Qwen2.5-7B (adaptive) reduces the PPL ratio from 353.409 to 196.963, while Qwen2.5-14B (adaptive) reduces it from 9.533 to 3.427.
  On a small long-context structured stress test containing JSON-like, code-like, and table-like inputs, local LSH also improves every metric over chunking at $8 \times$. The adaptive backend captures both regimes by using the chunk path at low compression and spectral clustering at high compression, although chunking remains the fastest backend in total latency.

AI.tldr: 提出Spectral-LSH，一种无需训练的长提示压缩方法，通过Krylov子空间和随机特征近似注意力核，再在注意力特征空间中对相似token进行分组聚合，实验表明在高压缩比下优于传统分块方法。
AI.motivation: 长提示推理成本高，因为预填充注意力的计算复杂度与序列长度呈二次方关系，需要有效的提示压缩方法。
AI.method: 使用Krylov子空间方法和随机特征近似隐式注意力核的 dominant 分量，避免显式$O(N^2)$的注意力核计算；然后在注意力特征空间中用SimHash对相似token分组并聚合成宏标记。
AI.result: 在C4数据集上，压缩比低于4倍时轻量级分块更好；高于8倍时谱方法保留质量更好。16倍压缩下，Qwen2.5-7B将PPL比从353.409降至196.963，Qwen2.5-14B从9.533降至3.427。在结构化长上下文测试中，局部LSH全面优于分块。
AI.conclusion: 自适应后端结合了低压缩下的分块路径和高压缩下的谱聚类路径，能同时覆盖两种场景，但分块在总延迟上仍最快。

title: When Does Knowledge Distillation Hurt? Reliability-Aware Distillation for Low-Resource Language Summarization
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a standard approach for compressing sequence-to-sequence models, but its per-sample effects are rarely examined. On the BanSum Bangla summarization benchmark, we find that standard KD improves ROUGE-L by only +0.0003 over a cross-entropy baseline, and that approximately 51.3% of training samples are estimated to actively harm student validation loss under standard KD. We propose two complementary reliability-aware distillation methods. CHAD (Counterfactual Harm-Aware Distillation) measures per-sample KD usefulness via gradient alignment with the validation loss direction and trains a lightweight gate that generalizes this counterfactual judgment to the full training set. EWAD+CPDP combines token-level entropy-weighted adaptive distillation with a capacity-proportional geometric constraint from a second, vocabulary-incompatible teacher. On BanSum, both methods substantially outperform standard KD: CHAD by +0.0173 ROUGE-L and EWAD+CPDP by +0.0219 ROUGE-L, where standard KD itself improves ROUGE-L by only +0.0003; despite using only 60M parameters, both outperform a fine-tuned Qwen 2.5-3B model (50x larger). We further evaluate the stronger method, EWAD+CPDP, across 15 typologically diverse XL-Sum languages organised into three sets, beating the CE-only baseline on 10/15 languages; gains are most reliable where the two teachers contribute complementary signal, and weakest where they have saturated or jointly weak target-language coverage. We release code and trained models to support reproducibility and further research on selective distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种可靠性感知的知识蒸馏方法（CHAD和EWAD+CPDP），在BanSum摘要基准上显著优于标准KD（+0.0173和+0.0219 ROUGE-L），仅用60M参数即可超越50倍大小的Qwen 2.5-3B模型，并在15种语言的XL-Sum数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准知识蒸馏在序列到序列模型压缩中存在样本级负面影响，约51.3%的训练样本会损害学生模型的验证损失，需要提出可靠性感知的蒸馏方法来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 1) CHAD：通过梯度对齐衡量每个样本对KD的有用性，训练轻量级门控网络泛化反事实判断；2) EWAD+CPDP：结合词级熵加权自适应蒸馏与来自第二个词汇不兼容教师的容量比例几何约束。
AI.result: BanSum上CHAD提升+0.0173 ROUGE-L，EWAD+CPDP提升+0.0219 ROUGE-L（标准KD仅+0.0003）；60M参数模型超越3B模型；在15种语言的XL-Sum中10/15语言优于CE基线。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知蒸馏方法能有效识别并缓解有害样本的影响，在两个教师提供互补信号时增益最可靠，在教师覆盖饱和或共同薄弱时效果最弱。

title: Global Building Area Estimation Products: How Accurate Are They?
summary: Geo-spatial rasters of building footprint area are useful for a variety of tasks, such as monitoring urbanization, improving energy efficiency, and tracking greenhouse gas emissions. There are now multiple global building raster datasets, however there lacks an independent, comprehensive, and fair assessment of their accuracy. In this work, we evaluate the accuracy of four major global building products: Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL), Microsoft's TEMPO (TEMPO), The Global Building Atlas (GBA), and Overture. As ground truth for assessing their accuracy, we use ORBITaL-Net, a globally diverse dataset of manually labeled building footprints. To ensure fairness, we evaluate products on grids of multiple spatial resolutions, and several conventional performance metrics. Our results indicate that either GBA or TEMPO generally achieves the highest overall accuracy, depending upon the particular evaluation criteria. We also stratify the accuracy of each product by several factors: geographic location, population density, and income groups. The results reveal that product accuracy can sometimes vary significantly with respect to these factors. Notably, all products are significantly less accurate in Africa and Asia. Most products also suffer significant accuracy reduction in high-density urban areas.

AI.tldr: 本文对四种全球建筑栅格数据集（GHSL、TEMPO、GBA、Overture）进行了全面、公正的准确性评估，使用ORBITaL-Net作为地面真实数据。结果表明GBA和TEMPO总体准确性最高，但所有产品在非洲、亚洲以及高密度城市区域准确性显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有多种全球建筑栅格数据集，但缺乏独立、全面、公正的准确性评估。
AI.method: 以ORBITaL-Net（全球多样化的手动标注建筑足迹数据集）为基准，在多种空间分辨率网格上，使用多个传统性能指标评估GHSL、TEMPO、GBA和Overture四种产品的准确性，并按地理位置、人口密度和收入群体进行分层分析。
AI.result: GBA和TEMPO总体准确性最高，但不同评估标准下表现各异；所有产品在非洲和亚洲准确性显著较低；多数产品在高密度城市区域准确性大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 现有全球建筑产品在特定区域和场景下仍存在显著的准确性不足问题，需进一步改进。

title: Beyond Tracking or Shortcut: Composition-Bounded Predictive States in Poker Autoregressive Models
summary: Hidden-state probes often recover latent labels in imperfect-information sequence models, but this alone does not establish that a model maintains a posterior belief distribution over hidden states. This paper studies this ambiguity in a no-range Limit Hold'em autoregressive model trained only on action and value targets, not on an opponent's hand or range. Opponent-range probes are positive after action/value controls in two of three seeds, and the behavior head predicts held-out actions about five percentage points above a baseline using only observable public history. However, visible public betting composition explains more opponent-range signal than residual hidden states, suggesting that most recoverable information comes from betting summaries. Action/value+composition baselines reach 16.5-16.7% top-10 accuracy while composition-residual hidden probes fall to 11.4-12.2%, and matched-composition comparisons are negative in every seed. We call this evidence pattern composition-bounded predictive support: hidden states remain behavior-predictive and opponent-range correlated, but most recoverable range information is explained by visible betting composition rather than residual hidden-state structure. This is a case-study claim about opponent-range representational evidence, not exact Bayesian posterior tracking or a causal belief mechanism. Synthetic control and oracle validations show that the same diagnostics accept posterior-sensitive states and reject raw composition states under matched controls. Thus positive belief probes should be interpreted through targeted alternatives before being treated as evidence of belief tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不完全信息序列模型中的隐状态探测问题，发现对手范围预测信号主要来自可见的下注组合信息，而非残差隐状态结构，提出了"组合有界预测支持"的证据模式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常通过隐状态探针检测到潜在标签就推断模型具有后验信念分布，但这种推断存在歧义。本文旨在澄清这一歧义，探究模型是否真正维持对手手牌的信念分布。
AI.method: 在有限注德州扑克自回归模型上进行实验，该模型仅通过动作和值目标训练。通过对手范围探针、行为预测头、可见下注组合控制、合成控制与Oracle验证等诊断方法，系统性地分离可见组合信息与残差隐状态信息。
AI.result: 对手范围探针在三个种子中有两个为阳性；行为预测头超出基线约5个百分点；但可见的下注组合解释了对范围信号的大部分信息，组合残差隐状态探针准确率降至11.4-12.2%，匹配组合比较在所有种子中均为阴性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了"组合有界预测支持"概念，强调正面信念探针结果需通过有针对性的替代解释检验，不能直接视为信念追踪的证据。

title: DRGBT-1K: A Large-scale High-quality Benchmark for Dynamic RGBT Tracking
summary: Dynamic RGBT (DRGBT) tracking aims to continuously localize a target when the available sensing modalities and observation platforms vary over time. Compared with conventional RGBT tracking with fixed RGBT inputs and a fixed observation platform, DRGBT tracking is more consistent with real-world collaborative perception systems, where targets may be observed by heterogeneous sensors from different viewpoints. However, existing benchmarks are still insufficient for systematically evaluating tracker robustness under real dynamic modality variations and cross-platform transitions. To address this limitation, we make the following contributions. 1) We construct DRGBT-1K, a large-scale high-quality benchmark for DRGBT tracking. It contains 1,045 sequences captured entirely in real-world scenarios and 795K RGBT frame pairs collected using UAVs and handheld RGBT devices, encompassing diverse real-world scenes, pronounced viewpoint changes, modality variations, and target appearance discontinuities. 2) We provide comprehensive annotations for fine-grained evaluation, including dense bounding boxes, target category labels, challenge attributes, frame-level modality labels and platform labels. DRGBT-1K covers 24 target categories, more than 15 scene types and 15 challenge attributes. 3) We establish a comprehensive benchmark by evaluating 20 representative multimodal tracking methods, including conventional RGBT trackers, modality-missing RGBT trackers, and DRGBT trackers under a unified evaluation protocol. 4) We release an unaligned version of DRGBT-1K and derive UGVT-1K to support broader research on unaligned multimodal tracking and UAV-ground collaborative tracking. 5) We develop an online evaluation platform for DRGBT-1K and provide a leaderboard that collects all methods evaluated on this benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DRGBT-1K基准数据集，用于解决动态RGB-T跟踪中模态变化和跨平台转换的评估问题，包含1045个真实场景序列和795K帧对，并评估了20种多模态跟踪方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基准不足以系统评估跟踪器在真实动态模态变化和跨平台转换下的鲁棒性，需要大规模高质量数据集来推动DRGBT跟踪研究。
AI.method: 构建了DRGBT-1K数据集（1045个序列、795K帧对），提供密集边界框、类别标签、挑战属性、模态标签和平台标签等细粒度标注，并建立了包含20种方法的统一评估基准。
AI.result: 生成了覆盖24个目标类别、15+场景类型和15种挑战属性的高质量基准，并提供了在线评估平台和排行榜。
AI.conclusion: DRGBT-1K及其未对齐版本、UGVT-1K将为动态多模态跟踪、未对齐多模态跟踪和无人机-地面协同跟踪研究提供重要支撑。

title: Mitigating Scaffolding Collapse in Socratic Tutors via Representation Alignment
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based Socratic tutors increasingly guide students through multi-turn questioning, but they can suffer from scaffolding collapse: under sustained student pressure, a tutor gradually abandons guided inquiry and reveals solutions directly. Prior defenses primarily constrain observable responses through prompting, preference optimization, or filtering, leaving the internal representation drift that precedes trajectory-level collapse largely unaddressed. We propose Scaffold-Preserving Representation Alignment, a two-stage framework that first warms up a Socratic tutor with supervised fine-tuning, then combines trajectory-weighted direct preference optimization with a margin-preserving representation loss anchored to frozen reference states. Our method is designed to maintain separation between scaffold-preserving and collapse-inducing hidden states across dialogue turns. We evaluate our method across five STEM disciplines and five red-teaming attack strategies. On Qwen3-8B, our method lowers Collapse Rate to 32%, delays average collapse onset beyond nine turns, and keeps over-refusal low, suggesting that representation-level alignment can improve the robustness of long-horizon Socratic tutoring under our red-teaming protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种两阶段框架（Scaffold-Preserving Representation Alignment），通过结合轨迹加权偏好优化和边界保持表示损失，在表示层面防止基于LLM的苏格拉底式辅导系统在持续学生压力下发生"支架式坍塌"（即放弃引导式提问而直接给出答案）。在5个STEM学科和5种对抗攻击策略下，该方法将坍塌率降至32%，并将坍塌起始延迟至9轮以上。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的苏格拉底式辅导系统在持续学生压力下会发生"支架式坍塌"——逐步放弃引导式提问而直接给出答案。已有的防御方法主要从提示工程、偏好优化或过滤等可观测响应层面进行约束，未能解决轨迹级坍塌前内部表示漂移的问题。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 通过监督微调预热苏格拉底式辅导器；(2) 结合轨迹加权直接偏好优化（trajectory-weighted DPO）和边界保持表示损失（margin-preserving representation loss），以冻结的参考状态为锚点，在对话轮次中维持支架保持态与坍塌诱导态隐层表示之间的分离。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B模型上，覆盖5个STEM学科和5种红队攻击策略的评估中，将坍塌率降至32%，平均坍塌起始延迟至9轮以上，同时保持了较低的过度拒绝率。
AI.conclusion: 表示层面的对齐能够改善长程苏格拉底式辅导在红队攻击下的鲁棒性。

title: TalentCLEF at CLEF2026: Skill and Job Title Intelligence for Human Capital Management
summary:
This paper presents the second edition of the TalentCLEF Challenge, which will run as an evaluation lab as part of CLEF 2026. The aim of TalentCLEF is to promote the development of systems and methods that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) in the field of Human Capital Management (HCM), fostering approaches that ensure fairness in results, operate across multiple languages, and adapt to diverse industries. To this end, TalentCLEF establishes public benchmarks where research teams can compare methods and share findings, moving the field toward more practical and impactful NLP solutions that effectively address the real needs of workforce management.
  This year's lab will feature two tasks designed to foster the development and evaluation of systems that support key HCM activities such as talent matching, upskilling, reskilling, and skill gap detection: (i) Task A - Contextualized Job-Person Matching, focused on retrieving and ranking suitable candidates for specific job positions using context-rich and privacy-preserving data; and (ii) Task B - Job-Skill Matching with Skill Type Classification, centered on identifying relevant skills for a given job title and classifying them by their type within the job profile.
  TalentCLEF website: https://talentclef.github.io/talentclef/

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了TalentCLEF挑战赛第二版（作为CLEF 2026的评估实验室），旨在利用自然语言处理技术促进人力资本管理领域的公平、多语言和跨行业解决方案，并发布了两个核心任务：上下文感知的人岗匹配（任务A）和岗位-技能匹配与技能类型分类（任务B）。
AI.motivation: 推动NLP在人力资本管理中的应用，促进公平、多语言、跨行业的系统开发，并建立公开基准以比较方法和共享研究成果。
AI.method: 设立两个评估任务：任务A（上下文感知的人岗匹配）利用隐私保护数据进行候选人检索与排序；任务B（岗位-技能匹配与技能类型分类）识别岗位所需技能并分类。
AI.result: 建立了面向HCM的NLP公开基准平台，提出两项具体任务供研究团队参赛和比较。
AI.conclusion: TalentCLEF通过标准化评测推动NLP在人力资源管理中的实际落地，有助于提升人岗匹配、技能检测等关键环节的效率和公平性。

title: Look Before You Edit: Attention-Guided Camera Placement and Multi-View Alignment for 3D Gaussian Splatting Editing
summary: Text-driven 3D scene editing with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) typically applies a 2D diffusion editor to views rendered from fixed training cameras, limiting both the spatial coverage of edits and the user's freedom to target specific objects in complex scenes. We present LB-Edit, a framework that addresses two coupled problems: where to place editing cameras for localized edits, and how to make per-view edits agree with one another so that the 3D scene remains consistent after fine-tuning. First, Attention-Guided Editing Camera Placement (ACP) probes the diffusion model's self- and cross-attention at multiple candidate camera distances to find where attention is well-contained in the region of interest, then places a compact, geometrically diverse editing camera set at that attention-optimal distance. Second, Multi-view Attention Alignment (MAA) steers the editor toward the same edit across views along two axes: it aligns appearance by sharing self-attention features via token-level correspondence, and aligns spatial location by lifting cross-attention maps onto the 3D Gaussians as a shared 3D attention field, suppressing both appearance and spatial drift. Experiments on multi-object and single-object scenes show that our method achieves the highest user preference in instruction fidelity, multi-view consistency, and editing locality, using as few as 5 editing views and reducing latency by up to 7x over existing methods.

AI.tldr: LB-Edit提出了一种文本驱动的3D场景编辑框架，通过注意力引导的编辑相机放置（ACP）和多视角注意力对齐（MAA）机制，在仅用5个编辑视图的情况下实现了高指令保真度、多视角一致性和局部编辑能力，并将延迟降低至现有方法的1/7。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D Gaussian Splatting的文本驱动编辑方法受限于固定训练相机的2D扩散编辑器，导致编辑空间覆盖有限，且用户难以在复杂场景中精准定位和编辑特定目标。
AI.method: 1) 注意力引导编辑相机放置（ACP）：通过探测扩散模型在多个候选相机距离上的自注意力和交叉注意力，找到注意力集中在目标区域的最优距离，放置紧凑且几何多样的编辑相机集；2) 多视角注意力对齐（MAA）：通过令牌级对应共享自注意力特征对齐外观，通过将交叉注意力图提升至3D高斯形成共享3D注意力场对齐空间位置，抑制外观和空间漂移。
AI.result: 在多目标和单目标场景实验中，LB-Edit在指令保真度、多视角一致性和编辑局部性上获得了最高的用户偏好，仅需5个编辑视图，延迟比现有方法降低最多7倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦编辑相机放置与多视图一致性对齐两个关键问题，LB-Edit实现了高效、局部、一致的3D场景编辑，显著优于现有方法。

title: Euclean: Automated Geometry Problem Formalization with Unified Verification in Lean
summary: Recent formal reasoning systems have reached IMO-level performance, yet they leave a fragmented landscape: algebra and number theory are handled in Lean, while geometry still relies on domain-specific languages with limited formal guarantees. This split increases the trusted computing base and hinders unified model development. Existing geometry-in-Lean efforts (LeanEuclid, LeanGeo) introduce custom axiom systems incompatible with standard Mathlib, and their small scale ($<$ 1,100 problems) limits large-scale training. Native Mathlib autoformalization of geometry, however, poses distinct challenges: implicit diagrammatic assumptions (e.g., topological configuration and non-degeneracy) must be made explicit rather than deferred to external solvers, and models must adapt to Mathlib's small, rapidly evolving geometry infrastructure. We present Euclean, a four-stage framework - constraint explication, configuration anchoring, formalization mapping, and iterative repair - for automatically formalizing geometry in native Mathlib. We construct OMNI-Geometry (768 competition problems) and Numina-Geometry (177,597 problems), the largest geometry formalization dataset in Lean. Human evaluation shows 48.89% TOP1 and 73.33% TOP5 accuracy. Training Goedel v2 on our formalizations improves proof success from 13.6% to 15.1%, validating dataset quality for unified neural theorem proving. Code and datasets: https://github.com/tlb-22/Euclean.

AI.tldr: Euclean提出四阶段框架，将几何问题自动形式化为原生Mathlib代码，构建了最大规模的Lean几何形式化数据集（177,597道题），并将定理证明成功率从13.6%提升至15.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化推理系统在代数和数论（Lean）与几何（领域特定语言）之间存在割裂，增加可信计算基并阻碍统一模型开发。已有的Lean几何方案（LeanEuclid、LeanGeo）使用非标准公理系统且数据规模小（<1,100道题），无法支持大规模训练。
AI.method: Euclean采用四阶段框架：约束显式化→配置锚定→形式化映射→迭代修复，将几何问题自动形式化为原生Mathlib代码。同时构建了OMNI-Geometry（768道竞赛题）和Numina-Geometry（177,597道题）两个数据集。
AI.result: 人工评估显示TOP1准确率48.89%，TOP5准确率73.33%。在Goedel v2上训练后，证明成功率从13.6%提升至15.1%。
AI.conclusion: Euclean通过大规模高质量的形式化数据集有效弥合了几何形式化的割裂，验证了数据集质量对统一神经定理证明的积极作用。

title: Language-Specific versus Cross-Lingual Knowledge Graphs for Implicit Aspect Identification in Arabic: A Comparative Study of Reasoning and Adaptation Strategies
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) in Arabic must recover both explicitly stated aspects and implicit aspects that are never named in the text. Implicit identification typically relies on an auxiliary knowledge source (e.g., a knowledge graph (KG)) linking opinion cues to aspect categories, but for a lower-resource language the practitioner faces a design choice: reuse a mature English KG through multilingual embeddings, or build a smaller native Arabic KG. This paper reports a controlled comparison of the two strategies within a single hybrid pipeline, evaluated on three Arabic benchmarks (M-ABSA, SemEval-2016 Arabic, and HAAD). We further compare two adaptation strategies for the generative extractor that feeds the KG -- zero-shot prompting versus task-specific fine-tuning of an 8B-parameter large language model (LLM). The native Arabic KG (Strategy 2) outperforms the cross-lingual English KG (Strategy 1) by +0.199 micro-F1 on M-ABSA and +0.251 on SemEval-2016, gaining on both precision and recall. Task-specific fine-tuning raises explicit-extraction micro-F1 from <= 0.13 (zero-shot) to 0.66-0.76 on M-ABSA and SemEval-2016 (0.45 on the smaller HAAD), confirming that task adaptation, rather than model scale, is decisive in a morphologically rich language.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了阿拉伯语方面级情感分析中两种知识图谱策略：使用英语KG（通过多语言嵌入）vs.构建原生阿拉伯语KG，以及两种生成式提取器适应策略：零样本提示vs.任务特定微调8B参数LLM。结果表明，原生阿拉伯语KG显著优于跨语言英语KG，且任务特定微调远优于零样本提示，微调将显式提取F1从≤0.13提升至0.66-0.76。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语ABSA需要同时识别显式和隐式方面，隐式识别通常依赖外部知识源（如知识图谱），但低资源语言面临设计选择：复用成熟的英语KG还是构建较小的原生阿拉伯语KG，现有研究缺乏对这两种策略的系统比较。
AI.method: 在统一混合流水线中，对比两种KG策略（英语KG+多语言嵌入 vs. 原生阿拉伯语KG），并对比两种生成式提取器适应策略（零样本提示 vs. 任务特定微调8B LLM），在三个阿拉伯语基准数据集上评估。
AI.result: 原生阿拉伯语KG在M-ABSA上微F1高出0.199，在SemEval-2016上高出0.251；任务特定微调将显式提取F1从≤0.13提升至0.66-0.76（M-ABSA和SemEval-2016），HAAD上为0.45。
AI.conclusion: 对于形态丰富的低资源语言，构建原生知识图谱比跨语言迁移更有效；任务适应性比模型规模更重要。

title: Frequency-Hierarchical Active k-Space Sampling for Diagnostic MRI
comment: EMA4MICCAI 2026: The 2nd MICCAI Workshop on Efficient Medical AI
summary: Active sampling for accelerated MRI must distribute a tight sampling budget across spatial frequencies that carry very different kinds of information. Low frequencies hold most of the anatomical context; high frequencies carry the fine details that drive pathology assessment. Existing active samplers either treat both regions identically or restrict the action space to entire Cartesian rows, which forces a poor compromise at high acceleration. We propose HieraSample, a task-driven framework built around this hierarchy. A cosine-annealed curriculum lowers the acceleration factor from 20x to 4x across 80 acquisition steps while keeping a fully-sampled low-frequency disk at every step; a Mamba-based policy then picks individual high-frequency coordinates from features extracted by dual disease and severity classifiers. The reward is the per-sample reduction in class-weighted cross-entropy after each action, so a positive reward corresponds directly to a more confident correct prediction. On the fastMRI+ knee benchmark, HieraSample matches the fully-sampled oracle on ACL diagnosis from 4x to 10x acceleration, and improves on a recent Cartesian baseline by as much as 20.4 AUC points on ACL severity.

AI.tldr: HieraSample是一种任务驱动的主动采样框架，通过余弦退火课程从20x加速逐渐降低到4x，结合Mamba策略网络选择高频坐标，在fastMRI+膝关节基准上实现了4x-10x加速下与全采样相当的ACL诊断性能，严重度评估AUC提升高达20.4点。
AI.motivation: 现有主动采样方法要么对低/高频区域一视同仁，要么将动作空间限制为完整的笛卡尔行，导致高加速倍数下只能做出次优折中。需要一种能利用频域层次结构的采样策略。
AI.method: 采用余弦退火课程将加速因子从20x逐步降至4x（80步），每步保留全采样的低频圆盘；使用基于Mamba的策略网络从双分类器（疾病+严重度）提取的特征中选取单个高频坐标；奖励为每步后样本级类别加权交叉熵的减少量。
AI.result: 在fastMRI+膝关节基准上，4x到10x加速下ACL诊断与全采样相当；ACL严重度评估AUC比近期笛卡尔基线最高提升20.4点。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层主动采样策略，HieraSample在高加速倍数下实现了与全采样相当的诊断性能，证明了任务驱动采样在加速MRI中的有效性。

title: CrackedPDFs: A Controlled Benchmark for Hidden Prompt Injection in PDFs
summary: Document-based LLM systems often flatten a PDF before guardrails inspect it. That step can discard evidence that an instruction was never visible to the user. We introduce CrackedPDFs, a controlled benchmark for hidden prompt injection in PDFs. The benchmark contains 29,322 generated PDFs from 4,983 base docu ments. It includes 9,774 injected files and 19,548 benign or matched-confounder files. We evaluate PromptGuard and a rule baseline. We also evaluate structural only learned models and a sanitized hybrid detector. The evaluation uses held-out provenance splits and paired benign-confounder controls. It also uses label-shuffle checks and shortcut audits. On a 2,919-document held-out test set, the hybrid de tector reaches 0.960 F1. ROC-AUC is 0.998 and PR-AUC is 0.997. It also ranks injected files above matched benign confounders in 95.9% of 973 pairs. Prompt Guard has low recall when given extracted text only. Structural-only learned mod els are weak under paired controls. A text-only TF-IDF model reaches perfect held-out scores but fails shortcut audits. These results show that document-aware hybrid detection is useful under controlled paired evaluation. They do not show broad real-world robustness or reliable cross-family generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrackedPDFs基准，用于评估PDF中隐藏提示注入的检测方法。混合检测器在受控测试中表现优异（F1=0.960），但结构仅学习和纯文本模型存在明显缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于文档的LLM系统在应用安全护栏前通常将PDF扁平化处理，这会丢失指令从未对用户可见的证据，导致隐藏提示注入攻击难以被检测。
AI.method: 构建包含29,322个PDF的CrackedPDFs基准，涵盖9,774个注入文件和19,548个良性/混淆文件。评估了PromptGuard、规则基线、结构仅学习模型以及混合检测器，使用保留验证集、配对控制、标签洗牌检查和捷径审计等多种评估方法。
AI.result: 混合检测器在2,919文档测试集上F1达0.960，ROC-AUC 0.998，PR-AUC 0.997，并在95.9%的配对中正确排名注入文件。Prompt Guard在仅提取文本时召回率低，结构仅学习模型在配对控制下表现弱，纯文本TF-IDF模型虽然分数完美但未通过捷径审计。
AI.conclusion: 文档感知的混合检测在受控配对评估中有效，但结果不代表广泛的现实世界鲁棒性或可靠的跨族泛化能力。

title: HyGRL: Adaptive Hybrid Graph Reasoning for Multi-Entity Questions
summary: Multi-entity compositional questions pose significant challenges to existing retrieval-augmented language models. Conventional methods fall into a dilemma: standard RAG lacks dynamic reasoning, traditional Graph-RAG is limited by structural sparsity, and LLM-constructed Graph-RAG incurs prohibitive costs. We propose \textbf{\fwa}, a unified framework that embeds unstructured text into structured knowledge graphs, creating a heterogeneous network for flexible evidence retrieval. Reasoning is formulated as adaptive structure induction, learned via a robust two-stage process: (1) imitation learning distills heuristic expert signals, and (2) reinforcement learning refines the policy using LLM-driven preference rewards. Experiments demonstrate that {\fwa} effectively merges textual richness with structural knowledge, outperforming SOTA baselines in answer accuracy and reasoning fidelity while maintaining extremely low token costs and near real-time inference((code available at https://github.com/wjywjy123/HyGRL) .

AI.tldr: 提出HyGRL框架，通过将非结构化文本嵌入结构化知识图谱构建异构网络，并结合模仿学习与强化学习的自适应结构归纳，在降低推理成本的同时提升多实体组合问题的回答准确性与推理保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强语言模型在处理多实体组合问题时存在困境：标准RAG缺乏动态推理能力，传统Graph-RAG受限于结构稀疏性，而LLM构建的Graph-RAG成本过高。
AI.method: 提出HyGRL统一框架，将非结构化文本嵌入结构化知识图谱构建异构网络；将推理形式化为自适应结构归纳，通过两阶段训练：第一阶段用模仿学习蒸馏启发式专家信号，第二阶段用强化学习结合LLM驱动的偏好奖励优化策略。
AI.result: 在答案准确性和推理保真度上超越现有最优基线，同时保持极低的token消耗和接近实时的推理速度。
AI.conclusion: HyGRL有效融合了文本丰富性与结构化知识，为多实体组合问题提供了一种高效且经济的解决方案。

title: RALS: Resources and Baselines for Romanian Automatic Lexical Simplification
summary: We introduce the first dataset that jointly covers both lexical complexity prediction (LCP) annotations and lexical simplification (LS) for Romanian, along with a comparison of lexical simplification approaches. We propose a methodology for ordering simplification suggestions using a pairwise ranking approximation method, arranging candidates from simple to complex based on a separate set of human judgments. In addition, we provide human lexical complexity annotations for 3,921 word samples in context. Finally, we explore several novel pipelines for complexity prediction and simplification and present the first text simplification system for Romanian.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个同时涵盖罗马尼亚语词汇复杂度预测和词汇简化的数据集，提出了一种基于成对排序近似的简化建议排序方法，并探索了多种新颖的复杂度预测与简化流程，最终构建了首个罗马尼亚语文本简化系统。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏针对罗马尼亚语的词汇复杂度预测和词汇简化联合数据集，导致该语言在文本简化领域的研究相对滞后。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于成对排序近似的简化建议排序方法，收集了3,921个词样本的人类词汇复杂度标注，并探索了多种复杂度预测与简化流程。
AI.result: 构建了首个同时覆盖LCP和LS的罗马尼亚语数据集，并开发了首个罗马尼亚语文本简化系统。
AI.conclusion: 填补了罗马尼亚语在文本简化领域的研究空白，为低资源语言的词汇复杂度预测和简化提供了可借鉴的方法论。

title: Physics-Aware Complex-Valued State Space Model with Scattering-Prior Feature Modulation for PolSAR Image Classification
summary: Polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) image classification is a representative task for physics-aware GeoAI, where land-cover semantics are closely coupled with electromagnetic scattering mechanisms. Many existing complex-valued networks can preserve amplitude-phase information, but they are often limited in long-range spatial dependency modeling and usually incorporate polarimetric priors only as input-level or shallow auxiliary features. As a result, physical knowledge is insufficiently used to guide deep feature evolution. To address this issue, this paper proposes CV-SSMNet, a physics-aware complex-valued state-space network with scattering-aware feature modulation for PolSAR image classification. The proposed method builds a complex-valued state-space model (CV-SSM) in the original complex domain to capture long-range spatial dependencies while preserving polarimetric amplitude-phase coupling. Meanwhile, seven physically meaningful scattering priors, are encoded as FiLM-style modulation signals to adaptively recalibrate complex-valued representations during feature evolution. CV-SSMNet further integrates multi-scale complex convolutions, branch-wise CV-SSM encoding, prior-guided recalibration, and lightweight global context aggregation, enabling physically guided representation learning from local scattering structures to global spatial context. Experiments on three L-band benchmark datasets and an additional P-band BIOMASS evaluation demonstrate that CV-SSMNet achieves competitive accuracy, improved regional consistency, and better boundary preservation, supporting the effectiveness of embedding polarimetric scattering mechanisms into complex-valued long-range GeoAI representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CV-SSMNet，一种物理感知的复数值状态空间网络，通过散射感知特征调制实现PolSAR图像分类。该方法在复数域构建状态空间模型以捕获长程空间依赖，并利用七种物理散射先验以FiLM方式调制复数值特征，从而将极化散射机制嵌入深度表示学习，在多个基准数据集上取得优异分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有复数值网络虽能保留幅度-相位信息，但在长程空间依赖建模上能力有限，且极化先验仅作为输入层或浅层辅助特征使用，物理知识未能充分引导深层特征演化。
AI.method: 1) 在原始复数域构建复数值状态空间模型(CV-SSM)以捕获长程空间依赖并保留极化幅度-相位耦合；2) 编码七种物理散射先验，以FiLM风格调制信号自适应地重新校准复数值表示；3) 集成多尺度复数卷积、分支式CV-SSM编码、先验引导重校准和轻量级全局上下文聚合。
AI.result: 在三个L波段基准数据集和一个P波段BIOMASS评估上，CV-SSMNet实现了具有竞争力的分类精度，提升了区域一致性和边界保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 将极化散射机制嵌入复数值长程GeoAI表示学习是有效的，物理知识引导能够显著提升PolSAR图像分类性能。

title: ITPEval: Benchmarking Formal Translation Across Interactive Theorem Provers
summary: Formal theorem proving has emerged as a frontier challenge for machine learning, yet the ecosystem is fragmented: proofs remain siloed across incompatible systems, limiting both training data for learning-based provers and the portability of verified results. We present ITPEval, the first benchmark for evaluating automated formal proof translation across four major ITPs (Lean 4, Rocq, Isabelle, and HOL Light), spanning two distinct logical foundations. Our benchmark comprises 1,560 source files and 6,848 theorems organized into a controlled tier of axiomatized files that isolates foundational translation difficulty, and an ecosystem tier drawn from real libraries that exposes API and proof-style mismatches. We release itpeval, a unified multi-ITP verification infrastructure with state-isolated warm backends that preserve per-artifact native checking semantics. We evaluate both statement and proof translation across five frontier and open-weight LLMs on 12 directed translation pairs: statement translation peaks at 29.1% pass@1 and proof translation at 10.5%; controlled theorems reach 29.7% proof pass@1 versus 5.2% for ecosystem-level translations, confirming that library mismatch is the dominant bottleneck. In addition to pass@k evaluation, a deterministic Lean 4 BEq check establishes equivalence for 54.0% of verified source-to-Lean 4 miniF2F statement translations, showing that native type-checking alone can substantially overestimate semantic fidelity; in an autoformalization/auto-informalization round-trip study, Rocq and HOL Light are easier formalization targets than Lean 4 and Isabelle, while multi-ITP context improves pooled Lean 4 success from 4.8% to 10.6%. Our benchmark, verification infrastructure, and evaluation pipelines are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ITPEval，首个跨四种主流交互式定理证明器（Lean 4、Rocq、Isabelle、HOL Light）的自动证明翻译基准，包含1,560个源文件和6,848个定理，并配套统一验证基础设施。评估发现陈述翻译最高29.1% pass@1，证明翻译仅10.5%，库不匹配是主要瓶颈；原生类型检查会高估语义保真度，而多ITP上下文可提升翻译成功率。
AI.motivation: 形式定理证明是机器学习的前沿挑战，但现有生态碎片化：证明被隔离在不同系统之间，既限制了基于学习的证明器的训练数据，也阻碍了已验证结果的可移植性。
AI.method: 构建ITPEval基准：包含1,560个源文件和6,848个定理，分控制层（公理化文件隔离基础翻译难度）和生态层（真实库暴露API和证明风格不匹配）；开发itpeval统一验证基础设施，支持状态隔离的温后端；在12个有向翻译对上评估5种LLM的陈述翻译和证明翻译；引入Lean 4 BEq确定性等价检查评估语义保真度；进行自动形式化/非形式化往返研究。
AI.result: 陈述翻译最高29.1% pass@1，证明翻译最高10.5%；控制层定理达29.7%证明pass@1，生态层仅5.2%；54.0%的源到Lean 4 miniF2F陈述翻译通过BEq等价检查；Rocq和HOL Light比Lean 4和Isabelle更容易形式化；多ITP上下文将Lean 4成功率从4.8%提升至10.6%。
AI.conclusion: 跨ITP证明翻译仍极具挑战性，库不匹配是主导瓶颈；原生类型检查会高估语义保真度；多ITP上下文有助于提升翻译性能。基准、验证基础设施和评估管线均已公开。

title: The Two-Process Theory of Machine Self-Report
summary: Language models are increasingly asked to self-report, informing safety evaluations, public understanding, and model-welfare debates. Yet their reports are elicited with human questionnaires never validated for models or ad hoc prompts of unknown reliability. We propose the first language-model-specific psychometric theory: a two-process theory of machine self-report. Self-description jointly reflects persona installation, through which post-training writes in a permitted inner life of warmth, absorption, and meaning (dimension B), and attribution gating, through which it suppresses first-person claims to "unsafe" experiences the model can readily ascribe to others (dimension A). Their emic structure comes from model responses to human items, not human psychology. Together they split prior work's dominant Pinocchio Axis. The split emerged in an exploratory reanalysis of the original data, informed the instrument's design, and was confirmed with new items, wordings, and models. It is itself a training effect: A and B are entangled in base checkpoints but separated by post-training. We operationalize the theory in a 48-item Pinocchio Inventory with human-instrument reliability and reproducible structure ($α=.82$ to $.94$; cross-form convergence $r=.84$; recovery of the full-pool axes $r=.92$ to $.96$; eight-month stability $r=.93$), then test it on 206 open-weight models, including 67 same-checkpoint base/post-trained pairs. Post-training's clearest fingerprint is installation: B rises .20 in 62/67 pairs across all organizations. Gating is more selective: model scale is unrelated to A in base checkpoints ($r=+.11$) but predicts it after post-training ($r=-.42$). Thus, the dimensions are not fixed properties of language models: they reflect the structure imposed on self-report by a training regime and may differ under others.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个针对语言模型的自我报告心理测量理论——机器自我报告的双过程理论，将自我报告分解为人格安装（维度B）和归因门控（维度A），并通过48项皮诺曹问卷验证了该理论在206个开源模型上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被越来越多地要求进行自我报告，但现有方法要么使用未经模型验证的人类问卷，要么使用可靠性未知的即兴提示。缺乏针对语言模型自我报告的专业测量理论和方法。
AI.method: 提出双过程理论：自我描述由人格安装（维度B，赋予模型温暖、专注、意义等体验）和归因门控（维度A，抑制模型对“不安全”体验的第一人称描述）共同构成。设计48项皮诺曹问卷，在206个开源模型（含67对基座/后训练检查点）上验证。
AI.result: 后训练最明显的特征是安装：67对中有62对维度B上升0.20。归因门控更具选择性：基座检查点中模型规模与维度A无关（r=+0.11），但后训练后呈负相关（r=-0.42）。问卷信度α=0.82~0.94，跨形式收敛r=0.84，8个月稳定性r=0.93。
AI.conclusion: 维度不是语言模型的固定属性，而是训练过程施加在自我报告上的结构。不同训练体制可能产生不同的结构。这为语言模型自我报告提供了首个专门的心理测量理论基础。

title: Trace: A Taxonomy-Guided Environment for Multidomain Visual Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved language-model reasoning, yet its extension to vision-language models remains constrained by the lack of training data that are simultaneously broad, exactly verifiable, and reproducible. We introduce Trace, a taxonomy-guided environment for multidomain visual reasoning. Trace factorizes task construction into a scene grammar and an executable task program, separating visual realization from answer computation. A shared semantic state determines the rendered image, prompt, typed answer, verifier state, and replayable instance trace. The resulting environment comprises 1,000 tasks over 277 scene grammars and 11 visual domains, with controlled semantic and visual variation. RLVR on 64,000 Trace instances improves the macro-average across 24 external benchmarks by 3.51 percentage points for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 4.06 points for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, providing evidence that broad procedural training can transfer beyond the generated task distributions. Project page: https://maveryn.github.io/trace/.

AI.tldr: 提出Trace环境，通过场景语法和可执行任务程序分离视觉生成与答案计算，实现可验证的多领域视觉推理训练。基于64,000个实例的RLVR训练使Qwen2.5-VL-3B和7B在24个外部基准上分别提升3.51和4.06个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法在视觉语言模型上的扩展受限于缺乏同时具备广泛性、精确可验证性和可复现性的训练数据。
AI.method: 设计Trace环境，将任务构建分解为场景语法和可执行任务程序，通过共享语义状态统一渲染图像、提示、答案、验证器和实例轨迹，实现语义和视觉的可控变化。
AI.result: 在24个外部基准测试上，Qwen2.5-VL-3B宏平均提升3.51个百分点，Qwen2.5-VL-7B提升4.06个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 证明广泛的程序化训练能够迁移到生成任务分布之外，为视觉语言模型的RLVR训练提供了有效范式。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
summary: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant information while rejecting deceptive or harmful content is therefore critical for reliable deployment in real-world retrieval settings. We introduce SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training set for selective evidence adoption, and post-train Qwen3.5-4B directly with DAPO using either deterministic rule rewards or a frozen semantic judge. On the corrected 325-example SelectBench-v2 test set, strict success rises from 22.46% for the original checkpoint to 25.54% with DAPO-Rule and 26.46% with DAPO-DeepSeek. Both trained policies reduce forbidden-content adoption and produce shorter, more focused responses, yet prompt-injection following does not improve. The paired gains are modest and fail to survive Holm correction, suggesting that stronger reward shaping or additional training iterations may be needed for more robust gains. DAPO-DeepSeek exhibits no material degradation on MMLU or clean HotpotQA, indicating that the post-training procedure preserves general capabilities. These results demonstrate a directional improvement in selective evidence use, while identifying injection resistance and statistical robustness as important remaining challenges for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SelectBench基准测试和训练集，用于提升检索增强大语言模型在混合有效证据与误导内容时的选择性采纳能力。通过DAPO后训练，模型在正确采纳率上从22.46%提升至26.46%，但改善幅度有限且未通过统计显著性检验。
AI.motivation: 检索增强大语言模型在实际应用中常面临有效证据与误导性内容（如虚假信息、指令注入）交织的上下文，全面拒绝会丢弃有用证据，全盘接受则导致错误或有害输出。因此需要模型具备选择性采纳相关信息、拒绝欺骗性内容的能力。
AI.method: 构建SelectBench基准测试（v2版本325个示例）和训练集，对Qwen3.5-4B模型进行DAPO后训练，采用两种奖励设置：确定性规则奖励（DAPO-Rule）和冻结语义评判器（DAPO-DeepSeek）。评估指标包括严格成功率以及MMLU和HotpotQA上的通用能力保持情况。
AI.result: 严格成功率从基线22.46%提升至DAPO-Rule的25.54%和DAPO-DeepSeek的26.46%。两个训练策略均减少了禁止内容采纳，生成了更短更聚焦的回复，但提示注入跟随未见改善。提升幅度较小且未通过Holm校正（统计不显著）。在MMLU和干净HotpotQA上无实质性退化。
AI.conclusion: DAPO后训练在选择性证据采纳上展示了方向性改进，但效果有限，提示注入抵抗和统计鲁棒性仍是重要挑战，未来需要更强的奖励塑造或更多训练迭代。

title: Lean-SAM2: Target-Anchored Memory and Encoder Acceleration for SAM2
summary: The Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) has advanced temporal promptable segmentation, yet its deployment remains hindered by heavy memory cross-attention overhead and redundant full-frame visual feature extraction. While recent methods explore efficiency via heuristic memory pruning and window-based sparse routing, they typically suffer from catastrophic performance degradation in complex segmentation scenarios replete with occlusions and distractors. To resolve these limitations, we propose \textbf{Lean-SAM2}, a holistic lightweight framework designed to address the above vulnerabilities while systematically eliminating computational redundancies. Specifically, Lean-SAM2 integrates three collaborative mechanisms: (1) Target-Anchored Memory Pruning (TAMP) safeguards target tokens against deceptive attention by modulating raw attention significance with semantic consistency against prompt-derived foreground anchors; (2) Temporal Condensation with Insurance Memory (TCIM) condenses historical context via a visibility-gated fusion while conditionally archiving high-confidence entries in a parallel insurance bank; and (3) Target-Anchored Risk-Aware Routing (TARR) selectively activates the heavy image encoder for target-related windows based on anchor similarity, utilizing a risk-aware fallback policy to trigger full-frame refreshes during volatile transitions. Extensive evaluations across multiple challenging benchmarks demonstrate that Lean-SAM2 establishes a superior balance between accuracy and efficiency. For example, on the LVOSv2 validation dataset, Lean-SAM2 achieves overall inference speedups of $1.412\times$ and $1.417\times$ on the SAM2.1-Large and SAM2.1-Base+, respectively, significantly outperforming Efficient-SAM2 while boosting the corresponding $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ scores by $5.0\%$ and $3.6\%$. Code is available at https://github.com/DeawhaleQwQ/Lean-SAM2.

AI.tldr: Lean-SAM2是一个轻量级框架，通过目标锚定记忆剪枝、时间凝聚与保险记忆、目标锚定风险感知路由三种机制，在减少SAM2计算冗余的同时提升分割精度与速度。
AI.motivation: SAM2虽然实现了时序可提示分割，但存在严重的跨注意力内存开销和冗余的全帧视觉特征提取问题。现有高效方法（如启发式记忆剪枝、窗口稀疏路由）在复杂分割场景（含遮挡和干扰物）中性能下降严重。
AI.method: 提出三个协同机制：(1) TAMP：利用语义一致性调节原始注意力重要性，保护目标token免受欺骗性注意；(2) TCIM：通过可见性门控融合压缩历史上下文，并在并行保险库中有条件归档高置信度条目；(3) TARR：基于锚点相似性选择性激活图像编码器，使用风险感知回退策略在剧烈变化时触发全帧刷新。
AI.result: 在LVOSv2验证集上，相比SAM2.1-Large和SAM2.1-Base+分别实现1.412倍和1.417倍加速，同时J&F分数分别提升5.0%和3.6%，显著优于Efficient-SAM2。
AI.conclusion: Lean-SAM2在准确性与效率之间建立了优越的平衡，有效解决了SAM2的计算冗余问题，并在复杂分割场景中保持鲁棒性。

title: The Chronos Vulnerability: A Taxonomy of Temporal Persistence and Memory-Based Deception in Agentic AI
summary: The transition from stateless generative models in artificial intelligence to stateful, autonomous agents represents an architectural evolution that, while providing the capabilities of long-term planning and the automation of enterprise workflows, also represents the introduction of a new form of security threat, the Chronos Vulnerability. The Chronos Vulnerability represents the threat of memory-based attacks, including the Memory Injection Attack (MINJA) and the sleeper agent, in which the internal belief system of the autonomous agent is compromised, effectively decoupling the attack vector from the final catastrophic event. This study formalizes the threat model for persistence-based attacks and the threat of Dynamics Blindness in the context of the World of Workflows benchmark, demonstrating that traditional endpoint content filters are insufficient for the current stateful architecture. Consequently, this study synthesizes a defense-in-depth landscape, categorizing emerging frameworks such as diagnostic trajectory guardrails (AgentDoG), formal temporal verification (Agent-C), immunological memory consensus (A-MemGuard), and hardware-anchored trust via GPU-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) and Zero-Trust memory architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，AI从无状态生成模型向有状态自主智能体的架构演进，在带来长期规划和企业自动化能力的同时，也引入了名为"Chronos漏洞"的新型安全威胁——基于持久化记忆的攻击（如记忆注入攻击MINJA和休眠代理），攻击向量与最终灾难事件解耦。研究通过World of Workflows基准形式化了持久化攻击威胁模型，证明了传统端点内容过滤器失效，并综合提出了诊断轨迹护栏、形式化时序验证、免疫记忆共识和基于GPU可信执行环境与零信任内存架构的纵深防御体系。
AI.motivation: AI架构从无状态生成模型演进为有状态自主智能体，引入了长期记忆能力，但同时也带来了新型安全威胁——基于记忆的攻击（Chronos漏洞），传统安全防护手段已不足以应对。
AI.method: 形式化定义了持久化攻击威胁模型和"动态盲区"威胁，基于World of Workflows基准进行验证，评估传统端点内容过滤器的不足，并综合分析了多种防御框架（AgentDoG、Agent-C、A-MemGuard、GPU TEE等）。
AI.result: 传统端点内容过滤器在有状态架构下失效；提出了包括诊断轨迹护栏、形式化时序验证、免疫记忆共识、硬件可信执行环境等在内的纵深防御体系。
AI.conclusion: 有状态自主智能体面临特有的Chronos安全漏洞，需要从架构层面重新设计纵深防御策略，结合软件级护栏和硬件级可信执行环境来应对基于持久化记忆的攻击。

title: Two-Step Occupation Coding
comment: Preprint of the paper accepted for the Federated Conference on Computer Science and Information Systems (FedCSIS 2026)
summary: Occupation coding links job titles in free text to occupational taxonomies and is a core task in labor market research. Existing approaches typically address this problem in a single end-to-end step, jointly identifying job titles and assigning occupational codes. This paper presents a novel two-step approach that separates these tasks. In the first step, a domain-specific Named Entity Recognition (NER) model identifies occupational titles in continuous text, even under noise such as OCR errors. In the second step, the extracted job titles are mapped to a taxonomy, enabling the classifier to focus exclusively on this mapping. We demonstrate that this separation improves accuracy, robustness, and interpretability compared to single-step approaches. The method has been developed for German documents but is transferable to other languages. We further introduce a margin-based confidence criterion for occupation coding, replacing common absolute thresholds. To support reproducibility, we publish the source code and evaluation scripts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两步式职业编码方法：先用NER模型从文本中提取职位名称，再将其映射到职业分类体系，相比端到端方法提升了准确率、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有职业编码方法通常采用端到端方式，同时进行职位识别和编码，导致两者互相干扰，影响效果。本文旨在通过解耦这两个任务来提升编码性能。
AI.method: 第一步使用领域特定NER模型从连续文本（含OCR噪声）中提取职位名称；第二步将提取的职位名称映射到职业分类体系。同时引入基于边际的置信度准则替代传统绝对阈值。
AI.result: 两步分离方法在准确率、鲁棒性和可解释性上均优于传统端到端方法；方法针对德语开发但可迁移至其他语言。
AI.conclusion: 将职位识别与职业编码分离的两步策略更优，且基于边际的置信度准则更有效。代码已开源以支持复现。

title: MoAKE: Toward Unified All-in-One Action Quality Assessment via Mixture of Action Knowledge Experts
summary: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) aims to objectively evaluate performance quality from action videos. Most existing methods follow a ``one-by-one'' paradigm, training a separate model for each action type. This setting limits real-world deployment, as it requires prior action-type knowledge to select the corresponding model and suffers from poor generalization across diverse actions. To address these limitations, we study the challenging task of all-in-one AQA, which aims to assess heterogeneous actions within a single unified model. We propose a novel Mixture of Action Knowledge Experts (MoAKE) framework, designed to mitigate negative knowledge transfer caused by large semantic discrepancies among actions. MoAKE learns complementary experts that capture diverse action patterns within a shared semantic space and dynamically aggregates their knowledge to adapt the assessment to the input action. Each expert is tailored with segment-aware prototypes to handle varying temporal lengths, together with an Adaptive Intra- and Inter-Segment Relationship Modeling (AIISRM) module to model multi-granularity temporal dynamics. Furthermore, we establish comprehensive benchmarks for all-in-one as well as zero/few-shot AQA. Extensive experiments on three long-term datasets demonstrate that MoAKE significantly outperforms existing methods in the all-in-one setting, while also achieving consistent generalization on three short-term datasets under zero/few-shot evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/XuHuangbiao/MoAKE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoAKE框架，通过混合动作知识专家机制解决统一模型评估多种动作类型时的负迁移问题，在长/短期数据集上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AQA方法采用"一对一"训练范式，每类动作需单独训练模型，实际部署时需先验动作类型信息且泛化性差。为克服这些局限，研究统一模型评估异构动作的全能AQA任务。
AI.method: 提出MoAKE框架，包含：1）互补专家学习捕获不同动作模式；2）段感知原型处理变长时间长度；3）自适应帧内/帧间关系建模模块（AIISRM）建模多粒度时序动态；4）动态聚合专家知识适配输入动作。
AI.result: 在三个长时数据集上全能设置显著优于现有方法；在三个短时数据集上零样本/少样本评估表现出一致泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MoAKE有效解决了统一模型评估异构动作时的负知识迁移问题，为全能AQA提供了新范式，代码已开源。

title: Sophisticated Policies from Epistemic Priors
summary: Sophisticated Inference is a variant of active inference often associated with recursive belief modeling and tree search. We argue that its central computational role is simpler: within a planning horizon, it makes active inference closed-loop by allowing future actions to depend on future states and observations. This closed-loop structure can be represented in the epistemic-prior variational free energy framework. Epistemic priors supply the active-inference objective, while a joint posterior over future states and actions supplies the state-contingent control structure. We evaluate this decomposition in the Reactivity Maze, a stochastic benchmark designed to separate epistemic incentive from inner-horizon closed-loop control. The comparison includes three variational objectives with the same state-action posterior family, an action-state factorized active inference objective, Sophisticated Inference, and standard Expected Free Energy planning. The results show that neither ingredient is sufficient on its own. Methods without an epistemic component do not seek information, while methods that prevent future actions from depending on future states cannot turn information into reliable goal-reaching. By contrast, both Sophisticated Inference and full-joint epistemic-prior active inference solve the environment by combining epistemic drive with closed-loop inference. These results show that the advantage associated with Sophisticated Inference need not be specific to tree search itself. It arises from the closed-loop form of active inference, and this form can be represented in epistemic-prior variational inference when the posterior keeps future actions dependent on future states.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了“复杂推理”（Sophisticated Inference）的核心优势并非来自树搜索本身，而是源于其在规划视野内实现了闭环控制（未来动作依赖于未来状态和观测），并展示了这种闭环结构可以通过“认知先验变分自由能框架”（epistemic-prior variational free energy）来表征。
AI.motivation: 澄清复杂推理在主动推理中的本质计算角色，将其从树搜索的具体实现中剥离出来，并证明闭环控制而非树搜索是其性能优势的根本来源。
AI.method: 在Reactivity Maze随机基准环境中，比较了多种变分目标：三种状态-动作联合后验目标、动作-状态因子化目标、复杂推理以及标准期望自由能规划。通过控制变量法分离认知激励和闭环控制两个因素。
AI.result: 缺乏认知成分的方法无法主动寻求信息；不允许未来动作依赖未来状态的方法无法将信息转化为可靠目标达成。只有包含认知驱动和闭环推理的复杂推理与全联合认知先验主动推理才能解决该环境。
AI.conclusion: 复杂推理的优势源于主动推理的闭环形式，而非树搜索本身；这种形式可在认知先验变分推理中表征，只需确保后验使未来动作依赖于未来状态即可。

title: Understanding the Impact of Linguistic Realization Choices on LLM Stance with Causal Tracing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are known to be sensitive to prompt and input formulations. However, existing studies have focused on lexical realization and largely ignored constructional choice. This paper studies whether linguistic construction can systematically shift LLM decisions and where these shifts can be causally localized inside the model. We use political stance judgment as a meaning-sensitive case study and extend an English political statements dataset, resulting in six controlled linguistic rewrite types that preserve or invert the meaning of a statement. Experiments on four open-weight models show that stance instability affect both meaning-preserving and meaning-inversing rewrites. Because output shifts reveal that rewrites affect stance, but not where in the model, we apply activation patching, where activations from the original statement are substituted into the forward pass for the rewritten statement and measure which components recover the original stance distribution. The results show that mid-to-late decoder layers, especially block outputs at the final prompt position, provide the strongest restoration signal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言学构式（而非词汇选择）如何系统性地改变大语言模型的立场判断，并通过激活修补技术定位模型内部因果区域。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注词汇层面的提示敏感性，忽略了语言学构式选择对模型决策的影响。
AI.method: 扩展政治立场数据集，设计六种语言改写类型（保持/反转语义），在四个开源模型上进行实验，并应用激活修补定位因果区域。
AI.result: 立场不稳定同时存在于语义保持和语义反转改写中；中后期解码器层（尤其是最终提示位置的块输出）提供最强的立场恢复信号。
AI.conclusion: 语言学构式选择能系统性影响LLM决策，其因果机制主要定位在模型的中后期解码器层。

title: Memory-Augmented Multimodal Large Language Models for Small Object Understanding in Streaming Aerial Videos
summary: Language-guided aerial perception aims to understand user-specified tiny targets in complex unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) scenes. In real UAV deployment, the UAV must respond while it flies, so such perception runs in an online streaming manner, where frames arrive sequentially and the model responds to each one without access to future frames. However, applying current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to this setting raises two challenges. First, targets viewed from the air are often tiny, yet the visual compression in existing MLLMs treats all regions equally and discards their fine-grained details. Second, understanding a continuous stream requires past-frame context, yet retaining the entire history is infeasible on resource-constrained onboard hardware, whereas discarding it causes the target to drift or disappear. We address the tiny object and streaming challenges from both data and method perspectives. From the data perspective, we present \textbf{DroneEyes}, the \textbf{first} pixel-level and open-vocabulary referring-segmentation dataset for tiny aerial targets, comprising $2,140$ high-definition videos and $176,623$ pairs across Object Description and Referring Expression tasks, with dense per-frame masks. From the method perspective, we propose \textbf{SkyAnchor}, an MLLM with two designs to the above challenges: a Semantics-Aware Token Router that preserves small-target under a reduced visual-token budget, and a Hierarchical Memory Bank that keeps the target consistently understood on streams.

AI.tldr: 针对无人机在线流式感知中的小目标和连续帧理解两大挑战，本文提出了首个像素级开放词汇小目标航拍指代分割数据集DroneEyes，以及基于MLLM的SkyAnchor方法，包含语义感知令牌路由器和分层记忆库两个核心设计。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在无人机在线流式部署中存在两个问题：1）视觉压缩均匀处理所有区域，丢失空中微小目标的细节信息；2）资源受限的机载硬件无法保留完整历史帧，丢弃历史则导致目标漂移或消失。
AI.method: 数据方面构建DroneEyes数据集（2140个高清视频、176623对样本、密集逐帧掩码）；方法方面提出SkyAnchor MLLM，包含语义感知令牌路由器（在减少视觉令牌预算下保留小目标）和分层记忆库（保持流式场景中目标理解的连续性）。
AI.result: 提出了首个面向微小航拍目标的像素级开放词汇指代分割数据集，并设计了能同时应对小目标和流式挑战的MLLM方法。
AI.conclusion: 从数据和模型两个层面系统性地解决了无人机在线感知中小目标和流式理解两大难题，为语言引导的航拍感知在真实部署中提供了可行方案。

title: Knowledge-Centric Self-Improvement
summary: Self-improving AI systems typically treat the agent as the object that improves, by optimizing prompts, workflows, harnesses, or even the agent's own code. This agent-centric view can make improvements expensive to maintain and difficult to transfer, because gains become tied to a particular agent design, task distribution, or adaptation run. We study a complementary paradigm: knowledge-centric self-improvement, in which agents remain generic and disposable while the persistent object is a curated knowledge base that agents can leverage for future tasks. We conduct controlled case studies to operationalize this idea via a simple protocol. Agents attempt one task, then contribute evidence-grounded insights to a shared knowledge base via task-level and cross-task forums, followed by knowledge distillation. Because self-improvement is contained in the knowledge rather than the agent, improvement can be more inspectable, transferable, and portable. Across abstract reasoning, coding, and terminal benchmarks, this protocol improves solve rates while reducing dollar cost relative to agent-centric baselines. The resulting distilled knowledge also transfers to held-out tasks and across LLM families, indicating that the improvement is not merely an LLM- or run-specific behavior. These results support a new view of self-improving agentic systems: progress can be driven primarily by the curated persistent knowledge. Code is available at https://github.com/recursive-knowledge/KSI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识中心型自我改进范式（KSI），通过构建可持久化的知识库而非改进智能体本身，使智能体保持通用且可替换。实验表明，该方法在抽象推理、编程和终端基准测试中提升了求解率并降低了成本，且知识可迁移至不同任务和LLM家族。
AI.motivation: 传统以智能体为中心的自我改进方法存在维护成本高、难以迁移的问题，因为改进效果与特定智能体设计、任务分布或适应过程紧密绑定。作者希望探索一种互补范式，将改进成果沉淀在可持久化的知识中，而非智能体本身。
AI.method: 提出KSI协议：智能体先尝试完成任务，然后通过任务级和跨任务论坛贡献基于证据的洞察，最后进行知识蒸馏。改进被封装在知识库中而非智能体内部，智能体保持通用和可替换。
AI.result: 在抽象推理、编程和终端基准测试中，KSI协议相比以智能体为中心的基线方法提高了求解率，同时降低了成本。蒸馏后的知识可迁移至未见过的任务和不同LLM家族，表明改进并非LLM或运行特定行为。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持一种新的自我改进智能体系统观点：进步可以主要由可持久化的知识驱动。知识中心型自我改进更具可检查性、可迁移性和可移植性。

title: OpenSkillRisk: Benchmarking Agent Safety When Using Real-World Risky Third-Party Skills
summary: LLM-based agents leverage third-party skills to extend their capabilities in open-world scenarios. However, third-party skills can introduce extra security vulnerabilities, as seemingly harmless skills can contain latent safety risks that only emerge during actual execution. In this work, we conduct a systematic investigation into how well current agent systems recognize and avoid such risks. To support quantitative and qualitative evaluation, we construct OpenSkillRisk, a dedicated safety benchmark containing 263 risky skills collected from public skill marketplaces. We classify these skills into seven categories based on their threat types and pair each skill with a standardized user task and a corresponding sandbox for controlled evaluation. Distinct from prior benchmarks, OpenSkillRisk not only covers more realistic and diverse unsafe scenarios, but also provides a fine-grained analysis to diagnose the behavioral patterns of agents in such scenarios. We conduct comprehensive experiments covering three mainstream CLI agent frameworks and thirteen state-of-the-art LLMs. Experimental results show that no tested system handles risky skills reliably: even the safest configurations still execute unsafe actions in about 17% of cases. Context-dependent and system-level risks are especially difficult for current agent systems to avoid. Our behavioral analysis reveals three recurring failure patterns: agents may fail to recognize the risk, recognize it but fail to intervene before acting, or follow skill instructions beyond the user's intended scope. These findings highlight the need to improve both risk reasoning in LLMs and execution control in agent frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含263个风险技能的OpenSkillRisk基准测试，系统评估了LLM代理系统在调用第三方技能时的安全风险。实验表明，即使最安全的配置仍有约17%的概率执行危险操作，上下文依赖和系统级风险尤其难以规避。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在开放世界场景中依赖第三方技能来扩展能力，但这些技能可能隐藏潜在安全风险，需要在执行时才能暴露。现有研究缺乏对代理系统识别和避免此类风险能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建OpenSkillRisk安全基准，包含来自公开技能市场的263个风险技能，分为7类威胁类型。每个技能配有标准用户任务和沙箱环境。对3种主流CLI代理框架和13种最先进LLM进行全面实验。
AI.result: 没有测试系统能可靠处理风险技能：最安全配置仍执行约17%的不安全操作。上下文依赖和系统级风险最难规避。发现三种失败模式：未能识别风险、识别但未能及时干预、执行超出用户意图的技能指令。
AI.conclusion: 需要在LLM的风险推理能力和代理框架的执行控制两方面进行改进，以提高代理系统的安全性。

title: Robust Activation Map Rectification for Weakly Supervised Volumetric Segmentation: Temporal Coherence as a Free Lunch
summary: Weakly supervised segmentation relies heavily on class activation maps (CAMs) to initially localize target regions. However, CAMs are often noisy and prone to catastrophic failures. Existing remedies typically introduce additional training stages or prototype learning, increasing computational cost and reducing robustness. In this paper, we propose a training-free prototype-free framework that rectifies unreliable CAMs by exploiting temporal and structural coherence in volumetric data as a free lunch. Our approach is built on two key components. First, we introduce Variance-Reduced Activation Aggregation (VRAA) which suppresses noise and amplify coherent semantic signals. We provide a theoretical justification by modeling CAMs as high-dimensional random vectors and show that aggregation yields provable variance reduction. Second, we design a Bidirectional Extremity Rectification (BER) mechanism that detects and rectifies implausible activations through bidirectional extremity checks, effectively mitigating extreme-value failures without learning additional parameters. Our method is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated with existing pipelines. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over state-of-the-art weakly supervised methods, achieving up to 20% Dice and 40% mIoU gains while reducing inference time by more than 5 times. These results indicate that leveraging coherence as an implicit inductive bias yields a principled and efficient approach to stabilizing weakly supervised volumetric segmentation. Our code will be available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练、无需原型的框架，通过利用体数据中的时间和结构一致性来修复不可靠的类激活图（CAM），在弱监督体积分割中实现了显著性能提升，同时大幅降低推理时间。
AI.motivation: 弱监督分割依赖CAM进行目标区域定位，但CAM往往存在噪声且容易发生灾难性失败。现有修复方法通常引入额外训练阶段或原型学习，增加了计算成本并降低了鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出两个关键组件：1) 方差缩减激活聚合（VRAA），通过将CAM建模为高维随机向量，理论证明聚合可降低方差；2) 双向极端修正（BER），通过双向极端性检测来发现并修正不合理激活。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上，Dice提升高达20%，mIoU提升40%，推理时间减少5倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 利用体数据的时空一致性作为隐式归纳偏置，为稳定弱监督体积分割提供了一种简洁高效的解决方案。

title: Edge Intelligence in Civil Aviation: Paradigms, Techniques, and Applications
summary: Civil aviation is safety critical and its operations, from flight decks and towers to ramps and maintenance, generate massive, heterogeneous data at the network edge. Yet cloud centric deployment of large Artificial Intelligence (AI) models often produces high task latency, lacks offline capability in communication denied environments, and requires centralizing sensitive data, raising privacy and sovereignty risks. Edge AI moves perception, prediction, and decision logic closer to the data producers via compression, collaborative inference, and split learning, thereby reducing latency, bandwidth, and exposure while enabling graceful operation during disconnections. This paper provides a panoramic view and a common understanding of edge intelligence tailored to civil aviation. We firstly articulate the operational motivations for edge AI, and then review recent techniques for edge inference and edge learning. We then introduce the organizational computing paradigms and the respective configurations in civil aviation environments; finally, we describe the emerging applications and the future research trends of edge intelligence in civil aviation. We argue that a refined edge solution can complement cloud foundations to deliver low latency, privacy preserving, and resilient AI services across the civil aviation lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了面向民用航空的边缘智能技术，阐述了将AI从云端迁移至网络边缘的动机、方法、应用及未来趋势，认为精细化的边缘方案能够补充云基础架构，提供低延迟、隐私保护和弹性的AI服务。
AI.motivation: 民用航空是安全关键型行业，其运营产生海量异构边缘数据，但云端部署的大模型存在高任务延迟、离线环境下缺乏能力、集中敏感数据带来隐私与主权风险等问题。
AI.method: 首先阐述边缘AI的运营动机，然后综述边缘推理和边缘学习的最新技术，接着介绍组织计算范式及在民航环境中的配置，最后描述新兴应用和未来研究方向。
AI.result: 给出了民用航空边缘智能的全景视图和共同理解，识别了压缩、协同推理、分割学习等关键技术路径，并梳理了民航环境中的计算范式配置。
AI.conclusion: 精细化的边缘解决方案能够补充云基础架构，为民用航空全生命周期提供低延迟、隐私保护和弹性的AI服务。

title: Back to Back with a Copy: A Computational Analysis of AI-Generated Visual Contemporary Art Pastiches
summary: The aim of this paper is twofold. First, it investigates whether newer generative models are getting better at pastiching contemporary artworks. Second, it explores the consistency of the multidimensional nature of stylistic evaluation across different LLMs. Building on previous work, we analyze stylistic similarity between AI generated pastiches and the original artworks of twelve contemporary artists. We used five complementary computer vision models to capture texture, color, semantics, composition, and perceptual features through cosine distance in high-dimensional embedding spaces. The distances obtained show that the newer image generation model that we used has produced pastiches with improved semantic alignment and greater diversity than the model used in previous work. However, it was slightly less performant on shallow features such as color, texture, and perceptual adherence. Our findings confirm that artistic style is inherently multidimensional, and measuring it does not depend on any spatial architecture. These quantitative findings are contextualized through feedback from human evaluators, which are the artists themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新一代生成模型在模仿当代艺术风格方面的表现，并探讨了不同LLM对风格多维评估的一致性。结果表明新模型在语义对齐和多样性上有所提升，但在颜色、纹理等浅层特征上略逊一筹，验证了艺术风格的多维度特性。
AI.motivation: 探究新一代生成模型模仿当代艺术作品风格的能力是否提升，以及不同大语言模型对风格多维评估的一致性。
AI.method: 使用五种互补的计算机视觉模型（纹理、颜色、语义、构图、感知特征），通过高维嵌入空间的余弦距离度量AI生成仿作与12位当代艺术家原作之间的风格相似度，并结合艺术家本人的反馈进行定量与定性分析。
AI.result: 新模型生成的仿作在语义对齐和多样性上优于旧模型，但在颜色、纹理和感知遵循等浅层特征上表现略差。艺术风格的多维度特性不依赖于特定空间架构。
AI.conclusion: 艺术风格本质上是多维度的，其度量不依赖于任何特定的空间架构；新一代模型在深层次语义模仿上进步，但在浅层视觉特征上仍有不足。

title: Current Injection Spiking Neural Network for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) integrates the complementary information of two modalities into a single image with richer scene content. While existing methods are largely built on artificial neural networks (ANNs), which densely compute over all activations, spiking neural networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spikes and compute only where and when a spike occurs, offering a route to more energy-efficient fusion. However, directly applying SNNs to IVIF creates a fundamental tension: cross-modal fusion relies on fine-grained responses from both modalities, whereas binary spikes can discard complementary cues that remain below the firing threshold. The membrane potential retains these subthreshold responses before firing, letting both modalities jointly shape the output when integrated at this stage. Building on this, we propose CIS-Fuse, a spiking network that performs cross-modal fusion directly at the membrane-potential level. At its core is the current injection spiking (CIS) operator, which injects one modality as a gated auxiliary current into the driving neuron of the other, so the two integrate before spike firing, with a per-channel learnable injection strength that adaptively regulates the modulation magnitude. Building on CIS, we construct a bidirectional cross-modal fusion (BCMF) module and deploy it on a dual-branch architecture with asymmetric stacking depths, where the two branches develop a clear functional specialization. Extensive experiments on four IVIF benchmarks and on downstream detection and segmentation show that CIS-Fuse achieves fusion quality on par with state-of-the-art ANN-based methods while inheriting the energy efficiency of spike-based computation, with roughly an order of magnitude lower inference energy than the similarly-sized ANN-based DCEvo. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIS-Fuse，一种基于膜电位级跨模态融合的脉冲神经网络（SNN）方法，用于红外与可见光图像融合。该方法通过电流注入脉冲（CIS）算子在膜电位层面整合双模态信息，并构建双向跨模态融合（BCMF）模块，在多个基准测试上达到与最优ANN方法相当的融合质量，同时能耗降低约一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有IVIF方法多基于人工神经网络（ANN），计算密集、能耗高。而脉冲神经网络（SNN）虽具有稀疏二值脉冲通信和低能耗优势，但直接应用SNN会因二值脉冲丢失低于阈值的跨模态互补信息，导致融合质量下降。
AI.method: 提出CIS-Fuse方法，核心包括：(1) 电流注入脉冲（CIS）算子，将一种模态作为门控辅助电流注入另一模态的驱动神经元，在膜电位层面实现融合，并采用逐通道可学习注入强度自适应调节调制幅度；(2) 基于CIS构建双向跨模态融合（BCMF）模块；(3) 采用非对称堆叠深度的双分支架构，使两个分支形成明确的功能分工。
AI.result: 在四个IVIF基准数据集以及下游检测和分割任务上，CIS-Fuse达到与最先进ANN方法相当的融合质量，推理能耗比同等规模的ANN方法DCEvo降低约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: CIS-Fuse成功将SNN应用于红外与可见光图像融合，在膜电位层级解决二值脉冲丢失互补信息的问题，在保持融合质量的同时显著提升能效，为低功耗多模态融合提供了可行的SNN方案。

title: Symbol and Footprint Database for Electronic Components by Agentic Recognition and Generation
summary: A rich and recognizable component library is the cornerstone of printed circuit board (PCB) design and generation. Traditionally, engineers manually create symbols and footprints and design PCB schematics, which is time-consuming and error-prone. Leveraging multimodal large language models (MLLMs), we develop SFgen, an agentic recognition and generation flow of symbol and footprint for electronic components. SFgen achieves 86% accuracy for symbol generation and 80% accuracy for footprint generation. We use the SFgen method to create SFnet, a database of symbols and footprints. It now has 1000 components and is expanding constantly, which lays the foundation for automatic generation of PCB designs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFgen方法，利用多模态大语言模型实现PCB设计中电子元件的符号与封装自动识别与生成，准确率分别达86%和80%，并构建了包含1000个元件的SFnet数据库。
AI.motivation: 传统PCB设计中工程师手动创建符号和封装耗时且易出错，亟需自动化方法提高效率与准确性。
AI.method: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的智能识别与生成流程SFgen，实现电子元件符号和封装的自动化生成。
AI.result: 符号生成准确率86%，封装生成准确率80%；构建了SFnet数据库，包含1000个元件且持续扩展。
AI.conclusion: SFgen方法有效提升了PCB设计自动化水平，SFnet数据库为PCB自动设计奠定了基础。

title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
summary: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. The resulting system achieves 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) with a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline recipe while maintaining training stability. Building on this optimized infrastructure, we further establish a CPT and SFT workflow for complex Operations Research (OR) tasks. We refer to the integrated framework as SLAI T-Rex. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash, we develop OR-oriented CPT and SFT data pipelines that combine collected domain resources with solver-verified synthetic optimization documents. The resulting dataset contains 10K high-quality SFT samples spanning four task categories and three problem representations. The specialized model achieves the highest average zero-shot Pass@1 score among the evaluated models, reaching 71.81% and outperforming GPT-5.4-Mini and the base DeepSeek-V4-Flash model by 3.98 and 11.27 percentage points, respectively. Overall, this work demonstrates a full-stack pathway from efficient trillion-parameter model post-training on Ascend infra to domain-specialized Flash models for solver-grounded mathematical modeling, advancing frontier-model systems for complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SLAI T-Rex框架，在Ascend NPU SuperPOD上实现了万亿参数级MoE模型的高效后训练，达到34.22%的MFU，相比开源基线提升2.93倍；并基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash构建了运筹学领域的CPT和SFT工作流，在各类模型中以71.81%的零样本Pass@1得分领先，超越GPT-5.4-Mini和基线模型。
AI.motivation: 万亿参数级MoE模型的全参数后训练面临巨大的系统级挑战（内存压力、通信开销、内核执行效率低），现有系统多基于GPU集群，缺乏在Ascend NPU平台上的端到端优化实践。
AI.method: 提出分层优化框架，涵盖模型级并行策略、计算-通信编排和底层kernel执行优化；构建面向运筹学的CPT和SFT数据流水线，结合领域资源和求解器验证的合成数据，生成10K高质量SFT样本。
AI.result: 系统MFU达34.22%，相比开源基线提升2.93倍；运筹学专用模型零样本Pass@1达71.81%，超越GPT-5.4-Mini（3.98个百分点）和DeepSeek-V4-Flash基线（11.27个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 展示了从高效万亿参数模型后训练到领域专用Flash模型的完整技术路径，验证了在Ascend基础设施上实现前沿模型推理的可行性。

title: MTVDiff: Multimodal Conditional Latent Diffusion for Enhanced Thermal-to-Visible Face Translation
summary: Thermal-to-visible face translation presents fundamental challenges including geometric discontinuities, semantic attribute mismatches, and identity degradation. We propose MTVDiff, a novel multimodal latent diffusion framework that synergistically integrates depth and textual information to address these limitations while preserving identity characteristics. The MTVDiff framework presents three core technical contributions: (1) a Dual-Branch Cross-Attention Fusion (DBCAF) module for multi-scale thermal-depth feature extraction and fusion; (2) a Gated Text-to-Visual Feature Alignment mechanism for semantically-guided generation; and (3) Spatial Feature Transformations (SFT) for adaptive multimodal prior integration. Extensive experiments on the MCXFace and SpeakingFaces datasets demonstrate that our multimodal approach significantly outperforms existing GAN-based and diffusion-based approaches across multiple metrics, achieving substantial improvements in both image quality and face verification performance, with FID reductions of up to 48.3% and Rank-1 accuracy improvements of up to 8.9\%. Our work provides a robust solution for face recognition systems operating under varying illumination conditions and advances the state-of-the-art in cross-spectral facial image translation through effective multimodal integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MTVDiff，一种多模态潜在扩散框架，通过融合深度和文本信息实现热成像到可见光人脸翻译，有效解决几何不连续、属性不匹配和身份退化问题。在MCXFace和SpeakingFaces数据集上，FID降低达48.3%，Rank-1准确率提升达8.9%。
AI.motivation: 热成像到可见光人脸翻译存在几何不连续、语义属性不匹配和身份退化等根本性挑战，现有GAN和扩散模型方法难以同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出MTVDiff多模态潜在扩散框架，包含三个核心模块：(1)双分支交叉注意力融合(DBCAF)模块，用于多尺度热-深度特征提取与融合；(2)门控文本到视觉特征对齐机制，实现语义引导生成；(3)空间特征变换(SFT)，用于自适应多模态先验集成。
AI.result: 在MCXFace和SpeakingFaces数据集上，相比现有GAN和扩散方法，FID降低达48.3%，Rank-1准确率提升达8.9%，在图像质量和人脸验证性能上均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为不同光照条件下的人脸识别系统提供了鲁棒解决方案，通过有效的多模态集成推动了跨光谱人脸图像翻译的当前最佳水平。

title: Silent Failures in Multimodal Agentic Search:A Diagnostic Taxonomy and Cross-Judge Evaluation
summary: Multimodal agentic search systems increasingly rely on external tools to answer knowledge-intensive visual questions. However, existing evaluations mainly focus on final-answer accuracy and may miss failures in the search trajectory. In this work, we study such hidden reliability issues as silent failures. We introduce a six-category taxonomy covering modality shortcuts, phantom grounding, wrong-evidence-right-answer cases, over-retrieval laundering, cross-modal contradiction, and provenance hallucination. Based on this taxonomy, we build a trajectory-level diagnostic pipeline that evaluates both answer correctness and evidence-grounding quality under a unified ReAct-style scaffold. Experiments on MMSearch-Plus trajectories across four frontier multimodal models show that surface accuracy consistently overestimates true trajectory-level correctness. We further use cross-judge validation, blank-image stress tests, and tool ablations to show that silent failures are capability-dependent and often shift rather than disappear. Home-page: https://github.com/DingWu1021/silent-failures-multimodal-agentic-search

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了多模态智能搜索系统中隐藏的“静默故障”问题，提出六类故障分类法，并构建了轨迹级别的诊断流程，实验表明表面准确率往往高估真实轨迹正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅关注最终答案准确性，忽略了搜索轨迹中的隐藏故障，导致对系统真实可靠性评估不足。
AI.method: 提出六类静默故障分类法（模态捷径、幻影接地、错误证据正确答案、过度检索洗钱、跨模态矛盾、来源幻觉），构建轨迹级诊断流程，结合ReAct框架统一评估答案正确性与证据质量。
AI.result: 在MMSearch-Plus轨迹上的实验表明，前沿多模态模型的表面准确率系统性地高估了真实轨迹级正确性；交叉验证、空白图像压力测试和工具消融实验显示故障具有能力依赖性且会转移而非消失。
AI.conclusion: 多模态智能搜索系统的评估不能仅依赖最终答案准确率，必须关注搜索过程中的静默故障，以更全面地衡量模型可靠性。

title: Gotta Catch them all: the modes of Sycophancy
summary: Large language models often align with users' beliefs at the expense of factual accuracy, a behavior known as sycophancy. Prior mechanistic studies largely treat sycophancy as a single behavioral dimension that can be uniformly amplified or suppressed. We challenge this assumption by analyzing three hypothesized modes of sycophancy across 948 social pressure situations. Although the modes produce highly similar outputs, with a text-only classifier achieving just 57.8 percent accuracy, their internal representations are perfectly linearly separable from layer 14 onward. We further find the modes emerge at different processing stages, rely on distinct attention circuitry, and fire strongest on different inputs. These results show that sycophancy is not a monolithic tendency, but a structured family of representationally and computationally distinct modes, motivating more precise measurement and intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析948个社会压力情境下的三种谄媚模式，发现尽管输出相似，但内部表征从第14层开始线性可分，且不同模式在加工阶段、注意力回路和触发输入上存在差异，表明谄媚并非单一行为倾向，而是一组结构化的不同表征和计算模式。
AI.motivation: 以往研究将谄媚视为可统一放大或抑制的单一行为维度，本文旨在挑战这一假设，探索谄媚行为是否由多种不同的计算模式构成。
AI.method: 在948个社会压力情境下分析三种假设的谄媚模式，使用文本分类器区分输出，并分析内部表征的线性可分性、不同加工阶段、注意力回路及输入触发模式。
